66150.recognize_zh: 三個分圖中的母細胞核質比高、細胞質少，但一端延伸出淡藍色的細胞質尾巴 (uropod)，使細胞呈不對稱的「手鏡形」(hand-mirror cell)；此為急性淋巴母細胞白血病的形態變異，本例為 T-ALL。
features: Medium-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio and round to mildly irregular nuclear contours
Moderately condensed to finely granular chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Cytoplasm scant and basophilic, concentrated at one pole as a pale blue tail-like projection (uropod), producing a hand-mirror shape
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods in the blasts
Panel C also shows a mature neutrophil for size comparison
66150.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows medium-to-large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei, granular chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Many blasts display polarized, lightly basophilic cytoplasm drawn out into a single tail-like projection, giving a hand-mirror configuration. Cytoplasmic granules and Auer rods are absent. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia with hand-mirror cell morphology; lineage assignment (T-lineage in this case) requires flow cytometry, as hand-mirror morphology has no independent lineage or prognostic significance.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with hand-mirror blasts
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts may also form uropods but usually show nucleoli, fine granules or Auer rods and are MPO positive.
Monoblasts have more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, folded nuclei and are nonspecific esterase positive.
B-ALL can look identical including hand-mirror forms, so separation depends on cytoplasmic CD3 (T-ALL) versus CD19/CD79a (B-ALL) by flow cytometry.
Hematogones are smaller with homogeneous condensed chromatin, show a maturation continuum on flow and lack aberrant antigen expression.

66406.recognize_zh: 白血球細胞質內塞滿約 6–7 顆大小一致的小橢圓形酵母體，每顆都有一圈透明暈（假莢膜）和偏一側的藍紫色新月形染色；細胞內小酵母加透明暈是組織漿菌（Histoplasma）的典型外觀。旁邊另一顆單核球則沒有吞入菌體。
features: Leukocyte with cytoplasm distended by about 6-7 uniform oval intracellular yeast forms, each roughly 2-4 um
Each organism has a clear surrounding halo (pseudocapsule) with a basophilic crescent or dot of stained cytoplasm
The host cell nucleus is dense and irregularly lobated, compressed to one side by the organisms
Adjacent monocyte with folded nucleus, lacy chromatin, and grey vacuolated cytoplasm contains no organisms
No kinetoplast is visible in the organisms; background red cells and a single platelet are unremarkable
66406.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two adjacent leukocytes. The upper cell has a dense, irregularly lobated nucleus pushed aside by approximately six to seven small, uniform oval organisms, each with a clear halo and a basophilic crescent of stained cytoplasm; no kinetoplast is identified. The lower cell is a monocyte with a folded nucleus and grey, finely vacuolated cytoplasm without organisms. The dense lobated nucleus of the infected cell could represent a neutrophil rather than a monocyte, although distortion by the organisms limits lineage assignment. Findings are suggestive of circulating intracellular Histoplasma capsulatum yeasts, consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis; confirmation by culture, antigen testing, or GMS/PAS stains is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes contain a bar-shaped kinetoplast next to the nucleus and lack the clear pseudocapsular halo seen around these yeasts.
Talaromyces yeasts are slightly elongated and divide by a transverse septum rather than budding, and are often extracellular; travel to Southeast Asia is typical.
Candida is larger (3-6 um), often shows pseudohyphae, and stains more uniformly without a halo.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent- or banana-shaped with a central nucleus and no surrounding halo.

66342.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑旁的造血組織被片狀大型組織球取代，細胞質豐富淡染、呈細纖維或泡沫空泡狀，核小而居中或偏位；右上角可見被擠壓的殘存造血細胞與淋巴球，符合儲積症巨噬細胞浸潤。
features: Sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic, fibrillary to vacuolated cytoplasm replacing marrow
Small round bland nuclei with low N:C ratio; some cells with foamy vacuoles
Focal pink granular extracellular material/hemorrhage within the infiltrate
Residual hematopoietic cells and lymphocytes concentrated at one edge (upper right)
Adjacent bony trabeculae without osteoblastic rimming; no atypia or mitoses
66342.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale fibrillary to foamy cytoplasm and small bland nuclei replacing the marrow adjacent to bony trabeculae. Residual hematopoietic cells and small lymphocytes are compressed at the periphery, and focal extravasated red cells are present within the infiltrate. No granulomas, necrosis or cytologic atypia are identified. Findings are consistent with marrow infiltration by storage cell macrophages of a lysosomal storage disorder.

ddx.vs: They are admixed with a clonal neoplasm such as CML or myeloma rather than forming a pure histiocytic infiltrate, with normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Crystal-storing histiocytes contain eosinophilic crystalline immunoglobulin and associate with a light-chain-restricted plasma cell or B-cell neoplasm.
Granulomas are discrete nodules of epithelioid cells with lymphocytic cuffs, unlike diffuse sheets of voluminous pale storage cells.

66086.recognize_zh: 中央的嗜中性球核分成 6 個葉，排列成環狀、葉間以細絲相連，這就是分葉過多嗜中性球（hypersegmented neutrophil）；背景紅血球可見淚滴狀與不規則形，提示可能有巨母紅血球性變化。
features: Mature neutrophil with six distinct nuclear lobes arranged in a ring and joined by thin chromatin strands
Coarse, condensed chromatin; no nucleoli
Pale pink cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules; cell size normal to slightly enlarged
Background red cells show poikilocytosis including teardrop and irregular forms
Scattered platelets present
66086.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with six discrete nuclear lobes connected by thin filaments, condensed chromatin and finely granular pale cytoplasm. The surrounding red cells show poikilocytosis with teardrop and irregular shapes; red cell size is difficult to judge at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a hypersegmented neutrophil (six or more lobes), which should prompt evaluation for megaloblastic anemia due to vitamin B12 or folate deficiency.

ddx.vs: Normal neutrophils have two to five lobes, and hypersegmentation is defined by any cell with six or more lobes or more than 5% with five lobes.
Macropolycytes are about twice normal size with a proportionally larger, often hypersegmented nucleus, whereas this cell is of near-normal size.
Hydroxyurea, methotrexate, or hereditary hypersegmentation give identical morphology and are separated by history, B12/folate levels and red cell indices.

65830.recognize_zh: 薄層血片中央一個細長、兩端較尖的新月形（banana-shaped）寄生蟲，細胞質藍紫色、中央有較集中的染色質與暗色瘧色素，旁邊可見淡色紅血球殘膜；新月形配子體是惡性瘧（P. falciparum）的特徵。
features: Single elongated crescent-shaped (falciform) parasite longer than the diameter of a red cell
Relatively pointed ends with bluish-purple cytoplasm, favoring a female macrogametocyte
Chromatin and dark malarial pigment concentrated toward the center of the parasite
Faint remnant of the host red cell membrane visible along the concave side
Surrounding red cells unremarkable; no ring forms identified in this field; scattered platelets
65830.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows a single elongated, crescent-shaped intraerythrocytic parasite that exceeds the diameter of a red cell, with bluish cytoplasm, relatively tapered ends and centrally concentrated chromatin and pigment. A faint remnant of the host red cell membrane is seen adjacent to the concave border. No ring forms are present in this field. Findings are consistent with a gametocyte of Plasmodium falciparum, with features favoring a female (macro)gametocyte; parasitemia should be quantified on additional fields.

ddx.vs: Male microgametocytes are more sausage-shaped with blunt rounded ends, paler cytoplasm and diffuse chromatin with scattered pigment.
Non-falciparum gametocytes are round to oval and fill an enlarged or normal-sized red cell rather than forming a crescent.
Sickle cells are uniformly pink without chromatin, cytoplasm or pigment.
Trypanosomes are extracellular with a nucleus, kinetoplast, undulating membrane and flagellum.

65638.recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構被大量融合的非壞死性肉芽腫與玻璃樣變纖維取代；高倍下多核巨細胞內可見星芒狀嗜酸性的星狀體（asteroid body，箭頭尖）與黃褐色卵圓形的 Hamazaki-Wesenberg 小體（箭頭），流式顯示無淋巴腫瘤且 CD4:CD8 比例顯著升高，符合類肉瘤病淋巴結病變。
features: Low power: lymph node architecture effaced by innumerable coalescent nonnecrotizing granulomas with hyalinized fibrous stroma
Tight epithelioid granulomas containing numerous multinucleated giant cells, rimmed by small lymphocytes
Giant cells with star-shaped eosinophilic intracytoplasmic inclusions (asteroid bodies, arrowhead) and clear/vacuolated cytoplasm
Small ovoid yellow-brown intracytoplasmic Hamazaki-Wesenberg bodies (arrow)
No caseous necrosis in the sampled fields
Flow cytometry: CD4-predominant T cells (CD4:CD8 markedly elevated) and polytypic CD19+ B cells (kappa:lambda ~1.1)
65638.describe_en: Lymph node section shows effacement of the architecture by numerous coalescent, well-formed nonnecrotizing epithelioid granulomas with intervening hyalinized fibrosis. The granulomas contain abundant multinucleated giant cells, some harboring star-shaped eosinophilic asteroid bodies, and there are small ovoid yellow-brown Hamazaki-Wesenberg bodies. No necrosis is identified. Flow cytometry shows no immunophenotypic evidence of a lymphoma, with CD4-predominant T cells and polytypic B cells. With negative AFB, Fite and GMS stains, findings are consistent with sarcoid lymphadenopathy.

ddx.vs: Infectious granulomas are usually necrotizing and organisms are demonstrated with AFB/Fite/GMS stains or culture, which were negative here.

ddx.dx: Hodgkin lymphoma or T-cell lymphoma with granulomatous reaction
ddx.vs: Would show Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+/CD15+) or atypical clonal lymphocytes between granulomas; flow and morphology show none.

ddx.dx: Sarcoid-like reaction to carcinoma or drugs (e.g., checkpoint inhibitors)
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; distinction relies on finding a tumor elsewhere or drug history.
Foreign body granulomas contain polarizable material and beryllium disease requires exposure history and lymphocyte proliferation testing.

65574.recognize_zh: 兩格周邊血中的嗜中性球核分葉減少（雙葉或不規則分葉），細胞質內可見多根細長的粉紅色棒狀結構，這是出現在成熟嗜中性球中的 Auer rods，屬於顆粒球發育不良。
features: Mature-sized neutrophils with hypolobated nuclei (bilobed in panel B, irregular in panel A)
Coarsely clumped mature nuclear chromatin
Multiple slender pink-red rod-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions consistent with Auer rods
Pale pink cytoplasm with reduced visible secondary granulation
Background red cells unremarkable
65574.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (two panels) shows mature neutrophils with hypolobated nuclei and coarse chromatin. The cytoplasm contains multiple slender, needle-like pink-red rods consistent with Auer rods, and conventional granulation appears reduced. Blasts are not present in these fields. Findings are consistent with dysplastic neutrophils containing Auer rods, supporting a myeloid neoplasm such as AML with myelodysplasia-related changes in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale blue, ill-defined peripheral cytoplasmic patches, not sharp pink-red needle-shaped rods.
Phagocytosed crystals are variably shaped, often refractile and pale, whereas Auer rods are uniform slender azurophilic rods that are MPO positive.

ddx.dx: Acute promyelocytic leukemia with differentiation (e.g., after ATRA/arsenic)
ddx.vs: Post-therapy APL may show Auer rods in maturing neutrophils, so clinical history and PML::RARA testing are required to separate them.

ddx.dx: Acquired pseudo-Pelger-Huët change without Auer rods (drug-induced, e.g., mycophenolate)
ddx.vs: Drug-induced hypolobation lacks Auer rods, which indicate a clonal myeloid process.

65510.recognize_zh: 第一次皮膚切片是 CD20+、EBER+ 的中大型 B 細胞增生，夾雜 CD3+ T 細胞；復發切片則換成 CD20−、EBER−、PD1+/CD3+ 的中小型淋巴球，顯示 EBV+ 大 B 細胞增生掩蓋了底下的濾泡輔助 T 細胞淋巴瘤（TFH lymphoma）。
features: Panel A: dense nodular dermal lymphoid infiltrate at low power
Panels B-F (first biopsy): medium to large atypical lymphocytes, CD20-positive with EBER-positive nuclei, interspersed CD3-positive T cells, high Ki-67
Panel G: recurrent diffuse dermal infiltrate at low power
Panels H-L (second biopsy): small to medium lymphocytes negative for CD20 and EBER, diffusely PD1-positive with CD3 positivity (inset) and high Ki-67
Loss of the B-cell/EBV component in the relapse biopsy (post-rituximab treatment effect)
65510.describe_en: The initial skin biopsy shows a dense dermal infiltrate of medium to large atypical lymphocytes that are CD20 positive and EBER positive, with interspersed CD3-positive T cells and a high Ki-67 proliferation index. The subsequent skin biopsy shows a diffuse infiltrate of small to medium lymphocytes that are negative for CD20 and EBER, and positive for PD1 and CD3, again with high Ki-67. Shared TRG rearrangement and TET2/DNMT3A/RHOA G17V mutations link the two biopsies. Findings are consistent with follicular helper T-cell lymphoma whose initial presentation was obscured by a prominent EBV-positive large B-cell proliferation.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: EBV+ DLBCL lacks an underlying PD1/CXCL13-positive clonal T-cell population and RHOA G17V/TET2 mutations, which were demonstrated here.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: This shows PD1-positive small/medium T cells with low Ki-67 and localized lesions, rather than widespread disease with high proliferation and TFH-associated mutations.
MF shows epidermotropism of CD4-positive T cells and lacks the EBV-positive B-blast component and RHOA G17V mutation typical of TFH lymphoma.
THRLBCL has scattered large B cells in a background of non-clonal CD8-rich T cells and histiocytes, without PD1-positive clonal TFH cells.

65510.stain: H&E, IHC: CD20, CD3, PD1, Ki-67, ISH: EBER

65382.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 PAS 染色下，造血組織中穿插著洋紅色、寬度一致、有分隔的平行壁菌絲，並呈銳角分枝，符合侵襲性麴菌症（invasive aspergillosis）。
features: PAS-positive (magenta) fungal hyphae infiltrating hematopoietic marrow
Hyphae with parallel walls, uniform narrow width and visible septa
Acute-angle (dichotomous) branching in several hyphae
Scattered small round PAS-positive structures possibly representing conidia or cross-sectioned hyphae
Background cellular marrow with a megakaryocyte and fat spaces; brown pigment granules present
65382.describe_en: PAS-stained bone marrow section shows cellular hematopoietic marrow infiltrated by numerous PAS-positive fungal hyphae with parallel walls, uniform width, regular septation and acute-angle branching. Occasional small round PAS-positive profiles may represent conidia or cross-sectioned hyphae. A megakaryocyte and fat spaces are present, and a granulomatous reaction is not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with invasive aspergillosis involving the bone marrow; culture or molecular confirmation of species is recommended.

ddx.vs: Mucorales hyphae are broad, ribbon-like and pauciseptate with right-angle branching and often stain weakly with PAS/GMS.
These hyaline septate molds are morphologically similar in tissue, so culture, PCR or specific immunohistochemistry is required.
Candida shows constrictions at septa (sausage links) with admixed budding yeasts rather than parallel-walled true hyphae.

65318.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中多顆中型母細胞，核圓或稍不規則、染色質細緻，細胞質灰藍色、無顆粒，並向一側拉出尾巴狀或手鏡狀突起（pseudopodia），部分細胞質邊緣有小空泡，這些都是 BPDCN 母細胞的典型外觀。
features: Medium to large blasts with high to moderate N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented eccentric nuclei with finely granular chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Moderate grey-blue agranular cytoplasm drawn out into tail-like pseudopodia (hand-mirror shapes)
Occasional fine vacuoles along the cytoplasmic periphery
A single segmented neutrophil with normal granulation and red cells with mild anisocytosis
65318.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a population of medium to large blasts with round to slightly indented eccentric nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and moderate grey-blue agranular cytoplasm. Many cells show characteristic tail-like cytoplasmic protrusions (pseudopodia) and fine peripheral cytoplasmic vacuoles. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are seen. Findings are suggestive of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, requiring immunophenotypic confirmation with CD123, CD4, CD56, TCF4 and TCL1.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts often have fine azurophilic granules, folded nuclei and nonspecific esterase or lysozyme positivity, and are MPO/CD14/CD11c positive unlike BPDCN.
Lymphoblasts usually have scant cytoplasm and express TdT with CD19/CD79a or cytoplasmic CD3, lacking strong CD123/TCL1 with CD4 and CD56.
NK leukemia cells have azurophilic granules and express cytotoxic molecules and CD2/CD7 with EBV positivity, but not CD123/TCF4.

65254.recognize_zh: 左上嗜中性球的核呈環狀捲曲（ring nucleus）、細胞質顆粒稀少；右側細胞為淡灰無顆粒細胞質、核分成數個圓小葉，似假 Pelger-Huët 樣；下方為退化碎裂的顆粒球，三者合起來是 MDS 的顆粒球發育不良（dysgranulopoiesis）。
features: Neutrophil with a coiled ring-shaped nucleus and hypogranular cytoplasm (upper left)
Hypogranular neutrophil with a few small round, poorly segmented nuclear lobes (pseudo-Pelger-Huet-like) (right)
Degenerating granulocyte with fragmented nucleus and smudged cytoplasm (bottom)
Coarsely clumped chromatin in dysplastic nuclei
Background elliptocytes/ovalocytes and a red cell fragment
65254.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several dysplastic granulocytes. One neutrophil has a ring-shaped nucleus with hypogranular cytoplasm, another has pale agranular cytoplasm with small rounded, incompletely segmented nuclear lobes resembling a pseudo-Pelger-Huet form, and a third shows degenerative nuclear fragmentation. Background red cells include elliptocytes and a fragment. In a patient with TP53-mutated MDS, the findings are consistent with dysgranulopoiesis.

ddx.vs: Inherited Pelger-Huet affects nearly all neutrophils with normal granulation and normal blood counts, whereas acquired pseudo-Pelger cells are hypogranular and accompany cytopenias.

ddx.dx: Drug-induced pseudo-Pelger change (e.g., mycophenolate, tacrolimus, valproate)
ddx.vs: Drug-related changes resolve after withdrawal of the agent and lack a clonal abnormality.
Apoptotic cells show round, pyknotic, disconnected nuclear fragments with dense eosinophilic cytoplasm, not ring nuclei with viable chromatin.

65190.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中漿細胞（包括雙核漿細胞）的細胞質內可見粗大、嗜天青/粉紅色的顆粒（箭頭），配合流式細胞儀 CD138+/CD56+/cKappa+ 的單株漿細胞群，為 Snapper-Schneid bodies。
features: Flow cytometry: CD138-positive population (green) with cytoplasmic kappa expression and CD56 positivity, CD19 negative
Plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm; one binucleated form
Coarse azurophilic to pink cytoplasmic granules in a subset of plasma cells (arrows), distinct from Russell bodies
Scattered small clear cytoplasmic vacuoles; one plasma cell with large confluent vacuoles (panel F)
Background of mixed marrow elements including granulocytic precursors and red cells
65190.describe_en: Flow cytometric plots show a CD138-positive plasma cell population with cytoplasmic kappa light chain restriction and aberrant CD56 expression, lacking CD19. Bone marrow aspirate smears show increased plasma cells, including binucleated forms, some of which contain coarse azurophilic/pink cytoplasmic granules and others showing prominent cytoplasmic vacuolization. The granules are coarser than normal primary granules and distinct from globular Russell bodies. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with Snapper-Schneid bodies.

ddx.dx: Plasma cells with Russell bodies (Mott cells)
ddx.vs: Russell bodies are larger, round, pale or eosinophilic immunoglobulin globules, whereas Snapper-Schneid bodies are smaller coarse azurophilic lysosomal granules.
Promyelocytes have perinuclear hofs as well but finer chromatin, nucleoli and abundant azurophilic granules throughout, and they are CD138 negative and MPO positive.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules in a myeloid or lymphoid neoplasm
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi inclusions are large, few, and occur in blasts or non-plasma cells, whereas here the granules are in clonal CD138+ plasma cells.
Mast cells have dense purple metachromatic granules filling the cytoplasm and are tryptase/CD117 positive rather than CD138/kappa positive.

64742.recognize_zh: 上方兩個巨大原紅血球（giant pronormoblast），直徑遠大於周圍細胞（對照 10 µm 比例尺），細胞質極深藍並有扇貝狀邊緣，核內染色質被擠向核膜、中央呈淡紫色毛玻璃樣包涵體，形成「燈籠細胞（lantern cell）」外觀，是 Parvovirus B19 感染的典型表現。
features: Giant pronormoblasts (roughly 30-40 µm by scale bar) with intensely basophilic, deep blue cytoplasm and scalloped borders
Large round nucleus with a pale, glassy lilac intranuclear inclusion and chromatin marginated to the nuclear rim (lantern-like appearance)
Perinuclear zone slightly paler than peripheral cytoplasm
Adjacent large macrophage with vacuolated foamy cytoplasm and a big nucleus (lower field)
Scattered smaller erythroid/myeloid precursors and erythrocytes; mature normoblasts appear scarce
64742.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two giant pronormoblasts with very large round nuclei containing pale, glassy intranuclear inclusions with peripherally condensed chromatin, surrounded by deeply basophilic cytoplasm with scalloped margins. A large vacuolated macrophage and a few smaller hematopoietic cells are also present, while maturing normoblasts are not conspicuous in this field. The findings are characteristic of parvovirus B19 infection (giant pronormoblasts/lantern cells); confirmation by parvovirus B19 PCR, IgM serology or immunohistochemistry is recommended, particularly in immunocompromised or hemolytic patients.

ddx.vs: Leukemic proerythroblasts form sheets of blasts without glassy intranuclear viral inclusions and show TP53 abnormalities, whereas parvovirus shows scattered giant pronormoblasts with erythroid hypoplasia.
Megaloblastic pronormoblasts have sieve-like open chromatin without a glassy inclusion and are accompanied by abundant maturing megaloblasts and giant metamyelocytes.
Normal pronormoblasts are smaller (about 14-20 µm) with visible nucleoli and no intranuclear inclusions.
These lack the glassy intranuclear inclusion with chromatin margination and are CD61- or CD138-positive, respectively.

64614.recognize_zh: 周邊血可見中小型、核質比高、染色質緻密的異常 T 淋巴球；淋巴結被一致的中小型細胞瀰漫取代，CD3+、CD4 與 CD8 同時陽性、TCL1 陽性，FISH 顯示 TCL1 與 TCRB 分離訊號，符合 T-PLL。
features: PB: small to medium lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei, condensed chromatin, and scant basophilic cytoplasm with small surface irregularities
LN H&E: diffuse effacement by monotonous small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei
IHC: tumor cells diffusely positive for CD3, with co-expression of CD4 and CD8
TCL1 shows nuclear/cytoplasmic positivity in the neoplastic cells
FISH: TCL1 break-apart probe and TCRB break-apart probe each show separated red and green signals indicating rearrangement
64614.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered small to medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, condensed chromatin, and scant basophilic cytoplasm. Lymph node sections show diffuse effacement by a monotonous population of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells, which are positive for CD3, co-express CD4 and CD8, and express TCL1. Interphase FISH demonstrates split signals with both TCL1 and TCRB break-apart probes. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia/lymphoma with TCRB::TCL1 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform nuclear convolutions, are usually CD4+ CD7− CD26−, and lack TCL1 expression and TCL1 rearrangement.
ATLL shows polylobated 'flower cells', CD4+ CD25+ CD7− phenotype, and HTLV-1 seropositivity rather than TCL1 overexpression.
Lymphoblasts have fine blastic chromatin and express TdT, CD34, or CD1a, all negative in this case.
T-LGL cells have abundant cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and a CD8+ CD57+ cytotoxic phenotype without TCL1 rearrangement.

64614.stain: Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD3, CD4, CD8, TCL1; FISH

64486.recognize_zh: 抹片中的肥大細胞呈圓形、顆粒滿布且看起來很成熟；切片可見大片圓形細胞聚集，核圓居中、細胞質豐富淡染，tryptase 陽性、CD30 陽性而 CD25 僅少數陽性，符合分化良好型全身性肥大細胞增生症（WDSM）。
features: Aspirate (A): increased round, mature-appearing mast cells densely packed with dark purple metachromatic granules; no spindle forms
Core (B): normocellular marrow adjacent to bony trabecula with a large paratrabecular aggregate of pale cells
Core high power (C): sheets of round cells with central round nuclei and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, resembling epithelioid cells
IHC (D): strong diffuse cytoplasmic tryptase positivity
IHC (E, F): weak membranous CD30 staining (E) and granular CD25 staining limited to a minor subset (F)
64486.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased round, well-granulated, mature-appearing mast cells without spindle morphology or hypogranularity. The core biopsy is normocellular with large aggregates of round cells with central nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm; at high power these cells lack spindling. The aggregates are strongly tryptase-positive, show CD30 expression, and CD25 is present only in a minor subset. In the absence of KIT D816V and with CD2 negativity, the findings are consistent with systemic mastocytosis, well-differentiated morphology.

ddx.vs: Conventional SM shows spindle, hypogranular mast cells with strong CD25 (and often CD2) expression and KIT D816V, unlike the round CD25-weak cells here.
Reactive mast cells are scattered singly without dense multifocal aggregates of 15 or more cells and serum tryptase is not markedly elevated.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or epithelioid histiocytic lesion
ddx.vs: The pale epithelioid sheets on H&E could mimic carcinoma or histiocytes, but tryptase and CD117 positivity with cytokeratin/CD163 negativity establish mast cell lineage.

ddx.dx: Myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA rearrangement
ddx.vs: Mast cells in PDGFRA-rearranged neoplasms are usually spindled, CD25-positive and accompanied by marked eosinophilia with FIP1L1::PDGFRA.

64486.stain: Wright-Giemsa, H&E; IHC: tryptase, CD30, CD25

64422.recognize_zh: 中性球（上排）與單核球（下排）的細胞質都布滿粗大、深紫色的嗜天青顆粒，但沒有 Döhle 小體或空泡；顆粒同時出現在單核球，提示 Alder-Reilly 樣顆粒，符合黏多醣症第六型。
features: Segmented neutrophils (top) with cytoplasm packed with coarse, dark purple azurophilic granules
Monocytes (bottom) with folded or indented nuclei and blue-grey cytoplasm also studded with coarse purple granules
Granulation involves multiple lineages (neutrophils and monocytes), unlike toxic granulation
No Döhle bodies or cytoplasmic vacuoles in the neutrophils
A small lymphocyte (top right) lacks prominent granules; red cells unremarkable
64422.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows segmented neutrophils and monocytes in which the cytoplasm is filled with coarse, dark azurophilic granules. The neutrophils lack accompanying Döhle bodies or vacuolation, and the monocytes are similarly granulated. An adjacent lymphocyte does not show conspicuous inclusions in this field. These Alder-Reilly-type granules, in the setting of low arylsulfatase B activity and urinary glycosaminoglycans, are consistent with mucopolysaccharidosis type VI (Maroteaux-Lamy syndrome).

ddx.vs: Toxic granulation affects neutrophils, usually with Döhle bodies, vacuoles and left shift, and does not involve monocytes.
G-CSF causes coarse granulation with Döhle bodies and left shift in neutrophils and resolves after therapy, in a clinical context of cytokine use.
Chediak-Higashi shows few giant fused granules rather than numerous uniform coarse granules, with albinism and immunodeficiency.
Morphology is similar (Alder-Reilly granules, lymphocyte inclusions); separation requires enzyme assay and gene testing (ARSB for MPS VI).

64294.recognize_zh: 肝臟切片左側門脈區內有大量增生的小膽管（ductular reaction），周圍纖維化並混有淋巴球等發炎細胞，部分膽管上皮內可見淋巴球；右側肝細胞相對保留、無明顯小葉壞死，配合免疫檢查點抑制劑用藥史，符合其誘發的膽管型肝損傷。
features: Portal/periportal area with numerous proliferating bile ductules lined by cuboidal epithelium (ductular reaction)
Loose fibroedematous stroma around ductules with a mixed infiltrate of lymphocytes and scattered other inflammatory cells
Some ductular epithelium shows reactive atypia with intraepithelial inflammatory cells
Adjacent hepatocyte plates on the right are relatively preserved without significant interface or confluent necrosis in this field
No granulomas, viral inclusions or neoplastic infiltrate evident
64294.describe_en: Liver biopsy shows a portal tract with a prominent ductular reaction composed of numerous small bile ductules lined by cuboidal epithelium within a loose fibroedematous stroma. There is a mild mixed portal inflammatory infiltrate of lymphocytes with scattered other inflammatory cells, and several duct profiles show epithelial injury with intraepithelial inflammatory cells. The adjacent lobular parenchyma is relatively preserved without significant lobular hepatitis in this field. In a patient receiving immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, findings are consistent with checkpoint inhibitor-associated hepatitis with a cholangitic/bile duct injury pattern.

ddx.vs: PBC shows florid duct lesions with granulomatous destruction of medium-sized interlobular ducts, AMA positivity and a chronic course rather than acute onset after drug exposure.
Obstruction produces ductular reaction with portal edema, neutrophils and bile plugs, and is identified by imaging showing a dilated biliary tree.
AIH shows plasma cell-rich interface and lobular hepatitis with emperipolesis and rosettes rather than a predominantly bile duct-centered injury.

ddx.dx: Hepatic involvement by lymphoma or metastatic adenocarcinoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma forms dense monotonous atypical infiltrates and metastatic adenocarcinoma shows infiltrative atypical glands, unlike these regularly spaced reactive ductules in inflamed stroma.

64102.recognize_zh: 胃黏膜固有層被成片、核偏心的漿細胞取代（A），插圖箭頭指出核內 Dutcher body；CD138 膜陽性（B）、MUM1 核陽性（C 插圖）、CD20 與 PAX5 陰性（E、F），加上單一輕鏈表現，符合胃部髓外漿細胞腫瘤。
features: Lamina propria expanded by sheets of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin and amphophilic cytoplasm, displacing gastric glands (A)
Inset: atypical plasma cell with an intranuclear Dutcher body (arrow) adjacent to gastric epithelium
CD138: strong membranous staining of the sheet (B); MUM1: strong nuclear staining (C inset)
Light chains per figure legend: lambda (C) negative and kappa (D) diffusely cytoplasmic positive, indicating monotypic expression
CD20 (E) and PAX5 (F) negative in the plasma cells
64102.describe_en: Gastric polyp biopsy shows the lamina propria diffusely expanded by sheets of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and focal atypia, including Dutcher bodies, separating residual gastric glands. The infiltrate is positive for CD138 and MUM1 and negative for CD20 and PAX5, with monotypic cytoplasmic light chain expression. Note that the figure legend labels panel C as lambda (negative) and panel D as kappa (positive), which conflicts with the case description stating lambda restriction; the correct light chain should be confirmed against the original report. In a patient with known myeloma, findings are consistent with extramedullary involvement by plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma (MALT) with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma contains a CD20+/PAX5+ neoplastic B-cell component with lymphoepithelial lesions in addition to monotypic plasma cells, whereas here CD20 and PAX5 are negative.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasma cell-rich gastritis (e.g., H. pylori)
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are polytypic with mixed kappa and lambda staining and lack sheets with Dutcher bodies.
Plasmablastic lymphoma shows large immunoblastic cells with high Ki-67, frequent EBER positivity and usually no prior myeloma history.

ddx.dx: Poorly differentiated carcinoma or signet ring cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma is cytokeratin-positive and CD138 can be positive in carcinoma, so keratin and light chain stains are needed when plasmacytoid morphology is present.

64102.stain: H&E; IHC: CD138, lambda, MUM1, kappa, CD20, PAX5

64038.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片可見多個巨核細胞，其中不少體積偏小、核為單一圓形或僅輕度分葉（hypolobated），散在於脂肪空泡間的造血組織中，為 MDS del(5q) 常見的巨核細胞形態。
features: Moderately to markedly cellular marrow biopsy with numerous fat spaces
Megakaryocytes readily identified and increased, many medium-sized with round monolobated or hypolobated nuclei
Megakaryocytes distributed singly rather than in tight clusters
Background granulocytic and erythroid precursors with maturation
No obvious blast sheets or fibrosis at this magnification
64038.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy (H&E, medium power) shows cellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis between fat spaces. Megakaryocytes are increased and many show round monolobated or hypolobated nuclei with relatively small cell size, distributed singly without clustering. No sheets of immature cells or evident fibrosis are seen in this field. The megakaryocytic morphology is suggestive of myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q), to be confirmed by cytogenetics.

ddx.vs: ET shows large mature megakaryocytes with hyperlobulated nuclei rather than small monolobated forms.
PMF shows clustered, atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei and reticulin fibrosis.
Hypolobated megakaryocytes are not exclusive to del(5q), so diagnosis rests on karyotype/FISH showing del(5q) without monosomy 7/del(7q).
Reactive megakaryocytes retain normal lobulation and a full size spectrum.

63910.recognize_zh: 三格免疫染色：CD34 在大量浸潤細胞呈膜狀陽性、CD123 有一群密集陽性細胞，而 TCL1 幾乎全陰性；CD34 陽性加 TCL1 陰性，支持急性骨髓性白血病而非母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤（BPDCN）。
features: CD34: diffuse membranous staining in a large proportion of the infiltrating mononuclear cells
CD123: strong staining in a dense subpopulation, forming a sheet-like area
TCL1: essentially negative in the infiltrate (only rare scattered background staining)
Hypercellular marrow with scattered fat spaces in all panels
63910.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stains on the bone marrow core biopsy show that the hypercellular infiltrate contains numerous CD34-positive blasts with membranous staining. CD123 highlights a dense population of cells, while TCL1 is essentially negative in the infiltrate. CD123 expression is not specific and can be seen in AML, whereas the combination of CD34 positivity and TCL1 negativity argues against blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm. Findings support acute myeloid leukemia with CD123 expression rather than BPDCN; correlation with MPO, CD4, CD56 and flow cytometry is recommended.

ddx.vs: BPDCN is typically CD34-negative and TCL1-, CD4-, CD56- and CD123-bright positive, whereas this infiltrate is CD34-positive and TCL1-negative.

ddx.dx: AML with mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation
ddx.vs: Clusters of pDCs in AML are CD123/TCL1-positive and small, while the CD34-positive blast population is separate; here TCL1 is negative.
B-ALL is also CD34-positive but expresses TdT, PAX5 and CD19, which must be excluded with additional stains.

63846.recognize_zh: 視野中紅血球偏小、中央淡染區擴大（小球性低色素），散在帶中央色點的標靶細胞（target cells）與一顆偏大、淡藍紫色的多染性紅血球；配合 HbE 家族背景，符合 HbE 相關疾病的血片。另外大量鋸齒狀邊緣紅血球屬於製片造成的皺縮假影。
features: Red cells predominantly small with increased central pallor (microcytic, hypochromic)
Scattered target cells with central hemoglobin dots
Occasional larger bluish-grey polychromatophilic red cell
Many crenated red cells (echinocytes), unevenly distributed, most consistent with a slide-drying or storage artifact
Mild anisopoikilocytosis with a few irregular and teardrop-like forms; no nucleated cells in this field
63846.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows predominantly microcytic, hypochromic red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis. Scattered target cells are present, and an occasional polychromatophilic red cell is seen. Numerous crenated red cells are distributed across the field and are most consistent with preparation artifact rather than a true acanthocytosis. No nucleated red cells, leukocytes or sickle cells are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a thalassemic hemoglobinopathy such as HbE disease or HbE/beta-thalassemia, to be confirmed by HPLC or electrophoresis.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows hypochromic microcytes and pencil cells with few target cells, low ferritin and a low red cell count, whereas HbE disorders show more target cells, a normal or high red cell count and an A2-window variant on HPLC.
Beta-thalassemia trait has a similar microcytic smear with basophilic stippling, and is separated by an HbA2 of about 4-8% rather than a 25-90% A2-window HbE peak.
HbC disease has abundant target cells with spherocytes and intracellular HbC crystals, and HbC elutes in a separate C-window on HPLC.
True acanthocytes are dense, lack central pallor and bear few irregular spicules, whereas the crenated cells here have regular short projections consistent with echinocyte artifact.

63782.recognize_zh: 骨小樑之間的髓腔被交織、呈漩渦狀的梭形纖維母細胞與膠原取代，幾乎看不到脂肪與正常造血，符合真性紅血球增多症後骨髓纖維化（post-PV myelofibrosis）。
features: Marrow space replaced by a hypocellular-to-moderately cellular proliferation of bland spindle cells in a collagenous stroma
Streaming and whorled fascicular arrangement of fibroblasts
Scattered dilated small vessels within the fibrotic stroma
Residual hematopoietic cells sparse and difficult to identify at this magnification; adipocytes essentially absent
Fragmented bony trabeculae without obvious osteosclerosis in this field
63782.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy sections show marrow spaces between bony trabeculae effaced by a proliferation of bland spindle-shaped fibroblasts arranged in streaming and whorled bundles within a collagenous stroma. Small dilated vessels are present, and fat is essentially absent. Residual hematopoietic elements are sparse in this field and are better assessed at higher power or with immunostains. Reticulin and trichrome stains are required to grade fibrosis. In a patient with a history of polycythemia vera, findings are consistent with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Morphology is essentially identical; separation relies on a documented prior PV phase (JAK2-mutated erythrocytosis) rather than histology.
Also histologically indistinguishable and defined by a prior ET history with normal hemoglobin rather than PV.
Fibrosis contains cohesive epithelial clusters that are keratin-positive, unlike the bland spindle fibroblasts here.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia or systemic mastocytosis with fibrosis
ddx.vs: These contain an infiltrate of CD20/annexin A1-positive hairy cells or CD117/tryptase-positive spindle mast cells, detectable by immunohistochemistry.

63718.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見大量小到中型、核質比極高、胞質極少且無顆粒的原始細胞，染色質較緻密，部分彼此擠壓成群；背景有許多淡粉紅、破碎的污跡細胞（smudge cells），在青少年極高白血球的情境下提示急性淋巴母細胞白血病，T 系需流式確認。
features: Numerous small to intermediate-sized blasts with very high N:C ratio
Round to irregular nuclei with relatively condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Scant rim of basophilic agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods
Cluster of larger blasts with nuclear moulding in the center of the field
Many pale pink disrupted smudge cells in the background
Normocytic red cells; platelets not appreciably seen
63718.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous blasts, ranging from small to intermediate in size, with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, relatively condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm. A cluster of slightly larger blasts with nuclear moulding is present, and there are abundant smudge cells, reflecting the fragility of the leukemic cells at a very high white cell count. No Auer rods, granules or dysplastic granulocytes are seen, and platelets appear decreased. The morphology is consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; with flow cytometry demonstrating CD2, CD3, CD5, CD7, CD8 and CD34 expression, findings support T-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts are morphologically indistinguishable and require flow cytometry showing CD19, CD22, CD79a rather than cyCD3.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of mature T-cell neoplasm (e.g., T-PLL)
ddx.vs: T-PLL cells have a visible single nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs and are TdT/CD34 negative mature T cells.
CLL shows mature small lymphocytes with block-like soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells in older adults, CD5/CD23/CD19 positive and TdT negative.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts are agranular too but express CD13/CD33/CD117 without cyCD3 and T-lineage antigens.

63654.recognize_zh: 箭頭處是一顆部分破裂的巨噬細胞，細胞質內與周圍散布大量卵圓形小體，每顆有深紫色核，部分可見旁邊的小棒狀動基體（kinetoplast），符合利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體；有些因推片而散落到細胞外。
features: Partly disrupted macrophage with numerous small oval organisms within and around its cytoplasm
Organisms approximately 2-4 µm with pale cytoplasm, dark purple nucleus, and in some a small rod-like kinetoplast
No clear halo around the organisms
Some organisms extracellular owing to smearing
Adjacent intact hematopoietic cells with fine chromatin and background red cells
63654.describe_en: Bone marrow smear shows a partially disrupted macrophage with numerous small oval organisms within and spilling out of its cytoplasm. The organisms measure approximately 2-4 µm and have a dark purple nucleus, with a small rod-shaped kinetoplast discernible in some; no surrounding halo is present. Findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes; PCR, culture, or serology can confirm the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts have a crescentic staining body with a clear halo and no kinetoplast, and stain with GMS/PAS.
Platelet clumps are anucleate, granular, and variable in size without a nucleus and kinetoplast.
Talaromyces yeasts are elongated with a transverse septum and lack a kinetoplast.

63590.recognize_zh: 這個視野主要是成熟中的顆粒球與右上方一個核深染、成團偏位的大細胞，胞質空泡在此圖中並不明顯；單看這張無法確認 VEXAS 的前驅細胞空泡化，需搭配同病例其他視野與 UBA1 檢測。
features: Cellular aspirate dominated by maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented forms)
Large cell at upper right with abundant pale pink cytoplasm and several dense, clumped, eccentric nuclear lobes (possible hypolobated/dysplastic megakaryocyte)
Large cell at left with abundant finely granular pink cytoplasm and a small eccentric nucleus
Cytoplasmic vacuoles in precursors are sparse and inconspicuous in this field
Scattered orthochromatic normoblast and platelet-rich background
63590.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows a cellular specimen with orderly-appearing granulocytic maturation. A large cell with dense, clumped, eccentric nuclear lobes and pale cytoplasm is present, possibly representing a dysplastic megakaryocyte, and another large cell with abundant granular cytoplasm is seen at left. Distinct cytoplasmic vacuolization of myeloid or erythroid precursors, the hallmark finding of VEXAS syndrome, is not convincingly demonstrated in this particular field. Blasts are not increased in this view. The image is only partially supportive of VEXAS syndrome and should be interpreted together with other fields and UBA1 mutation testing.

ddx.vs: MDS is defined by ≥10% dysplasia in a lineage with clonal abnormalities and blast enumeration, whereas VEXAS is defined by somatic UBA1 mutation with inflammatory features.
Reactive marrows lack dysplastic megakaryocytes and precursor vacuolization and show toxic granulation with an obvious infectious or inflammatory cause.
Copper deficiency shows vacuolated precursors and ring sideroblasts with low serum copper and no UBA1 mutation.

63526.recognize_zh: 低倍下視野中六顆嗜中性球周圍都黏附一圈小紫色血小板，排列成花環狀（rosette），而背景中游離血小板很少，這就是血小板衛星現象（platelet satellitism），會造成假性血小板減少。
features: Multiple neutrophils each rimmed by numerous adherent platelets forming rosettes
Platelets are small, purple, granular fragments of normal size attached around the cell membrane
Paucity of free platelets in the background
Neutrophils otherwise show segmented nuclei without toxic change evident at this magnification
Thick area of smear with overlapping red cells, limiting red cell morphology assessment
63526.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-medium power shows multiple neutrophils, each surrounded by a rosette of adherent platelets, while relatively few platelets lie free in the background. The platelets appear morphologically normal in size and granularity. The field is from a thick area with overlapping red cells, limiting assessment of red cell morphology. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism, an in vitro EDTA-dependent phenomenon that can cause spurious thrombocytopenia on automated counts; repeat count in a citrate or heparin tube and smear review is recommended.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumps form free-lying aggregates of platelets in the background or at the feathered edge rather than rosettes encircling neutrophils; both cause pseudothrombocytopenia.
Phagocytosed platelets lie within the neutrophil cytoplasm in vacuoles, whereas satellite platelets adhere to the external cell surface.
In true thrombocytopenia platelets are sparse throughout the smear without rosettes or clumps, and counts remain low in citrate-anticoagulated samples.

63334.recognize_zh: 左下方有一個核偏位、胞質大量呈粉紫色的火焰細胞（flame cell），周圍卻是許多中型、核質比高、染色質細緻的芽細胞（blasts）；同一張圖同時看到異常漿細胞與大量芽細胞，需考慮骨髓瘤合併或併發急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Numerous medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei and fine dispersed chromatin
Blasts with scant basophilic agranular cytoplasm; Auer rods not seen
Single flame cell: plasma cell with eccentric dense nucleus and abundant magenta-pink cytoplasm
A few smaller mature lymphoid/erythroid cells nearby
Hemodilute background with clumped red cells
63334.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely dispersed chromatin and scant basophilic agranular cytoplasm; Auer rods are not seen in this field. A single plasma cell with an eccentric dense nucleus and abundant magenta-pink cytoplasm (flame cell) is present among the blasts. Blast lineage cannot be established morphologically and requires flow cytometry. Findings are consistent with a flame cell in a marrow involved by acute leukemia, per the clinical description myeloblasts, raising concern for concurrent plasma cell neoplasm and AML (including therapy-related disease).

ddx.vs: Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with prominent nucleoli and more basophilic cytoplasm, and are CD138/clonal light chain-positive rather than CD34/MPO-positive.
Lymphoblasts can look identical morphologically; MPO cytochemistry and flow cytometry are required to assign lineage.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasma cell with flame morphology
ddx.vs: A single flame cell may be reactive; clonality by kappa/lambda and quantitation of plasma cells determine a neoplastic process.

63078.recognize_zh: BOB1 染色中，數顆散在的大型細胞呈均勻強烈的棕色陽性，明顯比背景小淋巴球的淡染更強；大細胞保留強 BOB1 表現，支持 NLPHL 的 LP 細胞，而非 BOB1 通常喪失的典型何杰金細胞。
features: Immunohistochemical stain for BOB1 at high power
Scattered large cells with strong nuclear and cytoplasmic BOB1 staining
Positive large cells are several times the size of background lymphocytes
Background small lymphocytes show weak or negative staining
Large cells are isolated rather than forming sheets
63078.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for BOB1 highlights scattered large cells with strong staining, clearly more intense than the weak to negative staining of the background small lymphocytes. The large cells are isolated within a lymphocyte-rich background without sheet formation. Preserved strong BOB1 expression, together with OCT2 positivity, supports an intact B-cell transcription program in these large cells. Findings are consistent with LP cells of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: HRS cells usually lack BOB1 and/or OCT2 and are CD30/CD15-positive, whereas the large cells here strongly express BOB1.
Neoplastic cells are also BOB1-positive, so the distinction depends on diffuse growth with loss of follicular dendritic meshworks and scant small B cells.
Immunoblasts retain BOB1 but are EBER-positive, show a spectrum toward plasma cells, and occur with preserved nodal architecture.

63270.recognize_zh: 高倍血液抹片中只看到兩顆中等大小的淋巴球，細胞質淡藍、邊緣略深藍且貼附周圍紅血球，染色質粗而不見核仁；沒有芽細胞，表示 TAM 在 8 週後已自行緩解，只剩反應性淋巴球。
features: Two medium-sized lymphocytes larger than a small resting lymphocyte
Moderate amount of pale to basophilic cytoplasm with deeper blue staining at the periphery and cytoplasm indented by adjacent red cells
Round to oval nuclei with coarse, clumped chromatin and no visible nucleoli
No blasts, cytoplasmic blebs or megakaryoblast-like features
Red cells normocytic and normochromic with occasional mild poikilocytes
63270.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows two medium-sized lymphocytes with moderate amounts of pale cytoplasm showing peripheral basophilia and indentation by adjacent red cells, and round nuclei with coarse chromatin without nucleoli. These features are those of reactive lymphocytes. No blasts are seen in this field, and red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with resolution of transient abnormal myelopoiesis at 8 weeks, with only reactive lymphocytes present.

ddx.dx: Persistent TAM or evolving myeloid leukemia of Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Would show blasts with fine chromatin, nucleoli and basophilic, often blebbed cytoplasm, which are absent here.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm, fine dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, unlike the abundant cytoplasm and clumped chromatin here.
LGLs have abundant pale cytoplasm containing distinct azurophilic granules, which are not seen in these cells.

63206.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片五格中可見多顆漿細胞：偏心圓核、豐富的深藍色胞質與核旁淡染區（hof），其中一顆為雙核漿細胞，部分胞質有細小空泡；左下格另有細胞陷在粉紫色無定形物質中。
features: Plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Binucleate plasma cell (upper left panel) and some larger plasma cells with more open chromatin
Occasional fine cytoplasmic vacuoles; classic flame cells with magenta cytoplasmic rims are not convincingly seen
Background maturing granulocytes, lymphocytes and red cells
One field with a lobulated-nucleus cell (likely megakaryocyte) surrounded by pale pink-purple amorphous material
63206.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (composite of five fields) shows plasma cells among maturing granulocytes and lymphocytes. The plasma cells have eccentric round nuclei with clumped to more open chromatin, abundant basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hofs and occasional fine vacuoles; a binucleate form is present, and several cells are larger than mature plasma cells. Classic flame cells are not clearly identified in these fields. One field shows a cell with a lobulated nucleus embedded in pale pink-purple amorphous material. Selected fields do not allow a plasma cell percentage, and clonality should be established by flow cytometry or kappa/lambda staining. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell infiltrate in the setting of immunoglobulin light-chain amyloidosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small, mature and polytypic, whereas binucleation, larger immature forms and light-chain restriction favor a clonal process.
Osteoblasts are larger, occur in clusters and have a pale zone separated from rather than abutting the nucleus.
Shows a spectrum from small lymphocytes through plasmacytoid lymphocytes to plasma cells with CD20 expression and MYD88 L265P, rather than a pure plasma cell population.

63142.recognize_zh: CD3 圈選的 T 細胞中，CD4+（綠）主族群幾乎都 CD26 陰性，只有少數 CD4+CD26+ 正常細胞向上延伸；CD26 流失是 Sézary 細胞較敏感的流式標記。
features: Dot plot gated on CD3+ T cells: CD4-FITC (x) versus CD26-PE (y)
Dominant CD4+ population (green) with absent CD26 expression
Minor tail of CD4+CD26+ normal helper T cells extending upward
CD4-negative T cells (red) are small in number
Pattern indicates an expanded CD4+CD26− T-cell population
63142.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis gated on CD3-positive T cells demonstrates a large CD4-positive population that is predominantly CD26-negative, with only a small residual CD4+CD26+ subset. The CD4-negative T-cell population is proportionally small. An expanded CD4+CD26− population (≥30% of lymphocytes) is a sensitive marker of Sézary cells and, with clonality and clinical erythroderma, supports Sézary syndrome.

ddx.vs: Benign erythroderma may show modest CD26 loss but not a dominant clonal CD4+CD26− population with a very high CD4:CD8 ratio.
ATLL can also be CD26-negative but is CD25 bright and HTLV-1 positive.
T-PLL typically expresses CD26 and CD7 and carries TCL1 rearrangement.

63014.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中幾乎看不到造血細胞，取而代之的是大量折光性、淡褐灰色的針狀結晶呈放射狀或成堆排列，周圍為纖維化間質與異物型巨細胞反應；這種針狀結晶加上異物反應、造血組織消失，是草酸鹽沉積症（oxalosis）骨髓侵犯的表現。
features: Numerous refractile, pale brown-gray needle-shaped crystals in dense sheaves and radial/rosette clusters (A, B)
Crystal deposits replacing marrow spaces and abutting pale bony trabeculae (A, B)
Fibrotic stroma with spindled fibroblasts surrounding crystal aggregates (B, C)
Foreign body-type multinucleated giant cells engulfing crystals (C)
Absence of residual hematopoietic elements in all panels
63014.describe_en: Composite of bone marrow trephine sections (H&E, low to high power). The marrow spaces are replaced by abundant refractile, pale brown-gray, needle-like crystals arranged in sheaves and radial clusters, adjacent to thickened bony trabeculae (A, B). The crystals are embedded in fibrotic stroma with a foreign body giant cell reaction (C), and no residual hematopoiesis is identified. Polarization, if performed, would be expected to show birefringent crystals; the photomicrographs have low contrast, which limits fine detail. Findings are consistent with bone marrow oxalosis, which should prompt evaluation for primary hyperoxaluria or end-stage renal disease.

ddx.dx: Gaucher disease or other storage disorder
ddx.vs: Storage disorders show sheets of macrophages with crinkled-paper or foamy cytoplasm, not extracellular birefringent needle-shaped crystals with giant cell reaction.
Immunoglobulin crystals are intracytoplasmic within histiocytes, eosinophilic, and associated with a clonal plasma cell or B-cell neoplasm, rather than extracellular birefringent oxalate sheaves.
Metastatic tumor shows cohesive epithelial cell clusters (keratin-positive) in fibrotic stroma, without crystal deposits.
Myelofibrosis retains atypical megakaryocytes and residual hematopoiesis in reticulin/collagen fibrosis and lacks crystals and foreign body giant cells.

62950.recognize_zh: CD5 染色下大片中型腫瘤細胞呈膜/質陽性（強度中等），少數細胞顏色更深（背景 T 細胞），內皮與間質細胞為陰性；B 細胞淋巴瘤出現異常 CD5 表現，縮小到被套細胞淋巴瘤與 CLL/SLL 的鑑別。
features: Diffuse membranous/cytoplasmic CD5 staining of intermediate-sized tumor cells
Moderate staining intensity in tumor cells, with scattered more intensely stained small T cells
Negative stromal/endothelial cells along small vessels
Monotonous sheet-like growth with round nuclei
62950.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD5 shows moderate membranous and cytoplasmic staining in the diffuse sheets of neoplastic lymphoid cells, with a few more strongly staining small reactive T cells and negative vascular and stromal elements. Aberrant CD5 expression in a B-cell lymphoma narrows the differential chiefly to mantle cell lymphoma and CLL/SLL. With cyclin D1 positivity and LEF1 negativity, findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: CLL/SLL is also CD5+ but is CD23+, LEF1+, and cyclin D1-, with proliferation centers.
PTCL is CD5+ (or shows CD5 loss) but tumor cells are CD3+ and lack B-cell markers.
CD5+ DLBCL consists of large cells with vesicular chromatin and is cyclin D1- and SOX11-.

62822.recognize_zh: Kappa 輕鏈免疫染色下，佔滿骨髓的大型、胞質淡而豐富的腫瘤細胞全為陰性，只見細胞間淡棕色的血清背景染色、一條血管內血清陽性，以及零星幾顆深染的殘存正常漿細胞；腫瘤細胞不表現輕鏈，不支持漿細胞腫瘤。
features: IHC for kappa light chain on a marrow core diffusely infiltrated by large tumor cells with scattered fat spaces
Tumor cells with pale abundant cytoplasm and round nuclei are negative
Fine interstitial brown background staining from serum immunoglobulin, outlining cell borders
Linear band of positive serum within a small vessel and a few adjacent positive cells
Rare scattered small cells with strong cytoplasmic staining consistent with residual plasma cells
62822.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for kappa light chain on the bone marrow core shows that the diffusely infiltrating large tumor cells with pale abundant cytoplasm are negative. Brown interstitial and intravascular staining reflects background serum immunoglobulin, and only rare scattered small cells with strong cytoplasmic positivity, consistent with residual plasma cells, are seen. Together with lambda negativity, lack of light chain expression argues against a plasma cell neoplasm despite the plasmacytoid morphology, supporting metastatic carcinoma.

ddx.vs: Myeloma cells would show strong granular cytoplasmic kappa staining in the neoplastic population, not just background serum staining.
Rare myelomas lack detectable light chains, but they remain CD138/MUM1 positive and cytokeratin, GATA3 and ER negative.
Carcinoma cells are light chain negative and express cytokeratin, GATA3 and ER, as in this case.

62758.recognize_zh: 嬰兒骨髓切片中有一個界線清楚的淋巴聚集，中央為較淡染的生發中心；CD79a、CD20 陽性的 B 細胞為主，BCL6 只標記中央生發中心細胞，CD3 陽性 T 細胞分布在周邊，符合反應性生發中心。
features: Well-circumscribed lymphoid aggregate within cellular marrow, with a paler central zone (germinal center)
Aggregate is non-paratrabecular with a mixed small and larger lymphoid cell population
CD79a and CD20 highlight a B-cell nodule with a surrounding B-cell mantle
BCL6 restricted to the central germinal center cells
CD3-positive T cells at the periphery of the aggregate and scattered in the interstitium
62758.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a cellular marrow containing a well-circumscribed, non-paratrabecular lymphoid aggregate with a paler central zone. Immunohistochemistry shows that the aggregate is composed predominantly of CD79a- and CD20-positive B cells, with BCL6 expression confined to the central germinal center cells and CD3-positive T cells distributed at the periphery. The organized compartmentalization of B and T cells supports a reactive process. Findings are consistent with a reactive lymphoid follicle with germinal center formation, in keeping with an immune-mediated condition such as autoimmune neutropenia.

ddx.vs: FL typically forms paratrabecular aggregates with BCL2-positive germinal center cells, whereas reactive germinal centers are BCL2-negative and non-paratrabecular.
MZL aggregates are composed of monotonous CD20-positive marginal zone cells often with intrasinusoidal spread and light chain restriction, without organized BCL6-positive germinal centers.
Blasts and hematogones are TdT- and CD34/CD10-positive immature cells in an interstitial distribution rather than an organized follicle with T-cell rim.
Hodgkin involvement shows scattered large CD30/CD15-positive Reed-Sternberg cells in a fibrotic mixed inflammatory background, not a B-cell follicle.

62758.stain: H&E; IHC: CD79a, CD20, BCL6, CD3

62694.recognize_zh: 淋巴球 gate 的 CD3 對 CD5 流式圖：綠色 NK 細胞 CD3 陰性、CD5 陰性，形成水平長條的大族群；藍色 T 細胞 CD3、CD5 皆陽性，CD5 強度正常，沒有 CD5 缺失的 T 細胞群。
features: Dot plot gated on lymphocytes: CD3-PC5.5 (x) versus CD5-PB (y)
Large green population CD3 negative and CD5 negative (NK cells)
Blue T cells CD3 positive with CD5 positive, vertically spread
Magenta CD3/CD5 double-negative population near origin (B cells), with small CD5-dim tail
No distinct CD3-positive, CD5-negative aberrant T-cell population
62694.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of the lymphocyte gate displays CD3 versus CD5. A large CD3-negative, CD5-negative population consistent with NK cells is present, together with CD3-positive, CD5-positive T cells and a small double-negative B-cell population. No CD5-loss T-cell population is identified, arguing against an aberrant T-cell LGL clone. Findings support the NK-cell expansion of the reported chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells.

ddx.vs: T-LGL typically shows a CD3-positive population with dim or absent CD5, which is not present here.
The CD3-CD5- NK phenotype is shared, so persistence and KIR restriction or clonality surrogates are needed.
HSTCL cells are CD3 positive, CD5 negative gamma-delta T cells with sinusoidal marrow and splenic involvement, rather than CD3-negative cells.

62630.recognize_zh: 低倍體液細胞塊中，數團鬆散細胞裡的大型細胞核呈棕色 MUM1 陽性，與較小的藍色陰性淋巴球混雜；背景亦有散在的單一陽性大細胞。
features: Low-power cell block with several loose aggregates and scattered single cells
Nuclear MUM1 positivity in the larger tumor cells within aggregates and singly dispersed
Admixed small MUM1-negative lymphocytes with blue nuclei
Clean background without significant non-specific staining
62630.describe_en: Low-power MUM1 (IRF4) immunohistochemistry on an effusion cell block shows multiple loose aggregates and scattered single cells in which the larger neoplastic cells display nuclear positivity, intermixed with smaller negative reactive lymphocytes. The distribution indicates that the large-cell population in the effusion carries a plasmablastic, MUM1-positive phenotype. In conjunction with HHV8/LANA positivity and lack of B-cell and immunoglobulin expression, findings are consistent with primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small, mature, sparse and HHV8-negative, unlike the large atypical MUM1+ population here.
Shares MUM1 positivity and CD20 loss but is HHV8/LANA-negative.
HHV8-negative, often CD20-positive, and seen in elderly patients without immunodeficiency.

62566.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片：左下方嗜中性球與右上方單核球的細胞質內都有多個 2–4 µm 的卵圓形小體，中央淡染並被透明空暈包圍，部分偏一端深染，符合莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）酵母型；血中白血球內見到病原提示瀰漫性組織漿菌病。
features: Neutrophil (lower left) containing several small oval intracytoplasmic yeast forms
Monocyte (upper right) with vacuolated cytoplasm containing multiple yeast forms
Yeasts about 2-4 um, oval, with a basophilic crescent/dot and a surrounding clear halo (retracted cell wall)
Uniform size without budding hyphae or kinetoplasts
Background red cells with scattered platelets; no parasites within red cells
62566.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil and a monocyte whose cytoplasm contains multiple small, oval, uniform yeast forms measuring approximately 2-4 um. Each organism has a basophilic eccentric crescent or dot surrounded by a clear halo, and the monocyte cytoplasm is additionally vacuolated. No kinetoplasts, budding hyphae or intraerythrocytic parasites are seen. Note that the neutrophil lies at the lower left and the monocyte at the upper right in this field. Findings are consistent with Histoplasma capsulatum within circulating leukocytes, indicative of disseminated histoplasmosis, typically in an immunocompromised host.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack the clear halo of Histoplasma.
Talaromyces yeasts are elongated or sausage-shaped and divide by a central transverse septum rather than budding.
Candida yeasts are slightly larger, often show pseudohyphae and stain darkly without a crescent-and-halo appearance.
Döhle bodies are pale blue peripheral cytoplasmic patches and phagocytosed platelets are granular, neither showing a uniform oval yeast with a halo.

62502.recognize_zh: CD3 染色中，大片小型淋巴球為陰性，只有散在的小淋巴球呈棕色膜狀陽性（T 細胞），部分成小群；表示浸潤的主體不是 T 細胞，而是背景 T 細胞混雜於 B 細胞浸潤中，支持 CLL。
features: Diffuse sheets of small round lymphoid cells that are CD3-negative
Scattered CD3-positive small T cells with membranous staining, singly and in small clusters
CD3-positive T cells are small and cytologically bland
Occasional CD3-negative megakaryocytes (upper left)
62502.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD3 shows a diffuse infiltrate of small lymphoid cells that are negative, with scattered admixed small CD3-positive T cells distributed singly and in small clusters. The T cells are small and cytologically unremarkable. This pattern indicates that the infiltrate is composed predominantly of non-T cells with a reactive T-cell background. Together with PAX5 and CD5 positivity in the infiltrate, the findings support involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: A T-cell lymphoma would show sheets of CD3-positive cells rather than scattered T cells in a CD3-negative infiltrate.
THRLBCL has abundant CD3-positive T cells surrounding rare large CD20-positive B cells, not a small-cell CD3-negative sheet.
Reactive aggregates contain a mixture of T cells and B cells with T cells often predominating.

62438.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中散在數個中型圓形細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少且帶泡狀空泡與不規則邊緣，中央有三顆細胞鬆散成小團，背景有粉紅色細絲狀物質；這些不屬於造血系列的鬆散小圓細胞，需考慮轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Scattered discohesive intermediate-sized round cells plus a small loose group of three cells centrally
Round nuclei with fine chromatin, high N:C ratio and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant pale-blue cytoplasm with irregular frayed borders and small cytoplasmic vacuoles/blebs
Faint pink fibrillary strands in the background, possibly neuropil
Occasional residual granulocytic precursors and platelet clumps; camera photograph with grey-tinted red cells
62438.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows scattered discohesive intermediate-sized round cells and a small loose group of three cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin and scant, frayed, focally vacuolated cytoplasm. Faint pink fibrillary material is seen in the background, and occasional residual myeloid precursors and platelet clumps are present. Dispersed tumor cells of this type can be mistaken for blasts; the presence of cell groups and fibrillary matrix favors a non-hematopoietic small round blue cell tumor. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma, pending immunophenotypic confirmation (CD45-negative, PHOX2B/synaptophysin-positive).

ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts are evenly dispersed without cell groups or fibrillary matrix and are CD45-positive by flow cytometry.
Ewing cells also show vacuolated cytoplasm but lack neuropil and are CD99/NKX2.2-positive with EWSR1 rearrangement.
Rhabdomyosarcoma may show vacuolated cytoplasm and multinucleated forms and is desmin/myogenin-positive.
Hematogones are smaller with homogeneous condensed chromatin and scant non-vacuolated cytoplasm, and show a maturing B-cell flow pattern.

62374.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞豐富，可見許多母細胞，並有幾個核呈單葉或分離小圓葉的異常巨核細胞（hypolobated/separated-lobe megakaryocytes），這種巨核細胞發育不良是 inv(3)/t(3;3) AML 的典型線索。
features: Hypercellular particle-rich aspirate with numerous fat vacuoles
Increased blasts: medium-sized cells with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Dysplastic megakaryocytes with monolobated nuclei or multiple small separated nuclear lobes
Admixed erythroid precursors and maturing myeloid cells
Megakaryocytes are not decreased despite the leukemic infiltrate
62374.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa) is hypercellular with abundant particles. There is an increase in blasts with fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm, admixed with residual erythroid and granulocytic precursors. Megakaryocytes are readily identified and are dysplastic, including forms with monolobated nuclei and forms with multiple small separated nuclear lobes. A formal blast count and cytogenetic studies are required, but the findings are suggestive of AML with inv(3)(q21q26.2)/t(3;3)(q21;q26.2), GATA2::MECOM.

ddx.vs: MDS-EB has fewer than 20% blasts (in WHO 2016); note that 3q26 rearranged cases behave aggressively regardless, and karyotype/FISH identifies them.
del(5q) has hypolobated megakaryocytes but blasts are under 5% and the karyotype shows del(5q) rather than 3q26 rearrangement.
AML-MRC shows multilineage dysplasia too, but MECOM rearrangement on cytogenetics takes precedence for classification.

62310.recognize_zh: 流式細胞儀散點圖：藍色 CD19 陽性 B 細胞群呈 CD45 亮、CD20 極亮（超出刻度），並同時表現 CD25、CD103 與亮 CD11c，而 CD3 陰性；CD11c/CD25/CD103 三者皆陽性的單一 B 細胞群就是毛細胞白血病（HCL）的典型表型。
features: Six dot plots gated on lymphocytes, with CD19 on the x-axis in five plots
Blue population: CD19-positive B cells with bright CD45 expression
CD25 positive on the B-cell population (arrow)
CD103 positive, gated as CD19+CD103+ population
Bright CD11c co-expression (arrow); CD3-negative
Very bright CD20, piling against the upper axis limit (thick arrow); red events are residual T/NK cells
62310.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plots gated on lymphocytes show a dominant CD19-positive B-cell population (blue) with bright CD45 and very bright CD20 expression, the latter reaching the upper limit of the scale. This population co-expresses CD25, CD103 and bright CD11c and is negative for surface CD3, whereas the residual red events represent CD3-positive T cells and other lymphocytes. Light-chain restriction is not shown in these plots. The CD11c+/CD25+/CD103+ bright CD20 phenotype is characteristic of hairy cell leukemia; CD123 and annexin A1 or BRAF V600E testing can provide further confirmation.

ddx.dx: Splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli (HCL variant)
ddx.vs: HCL variant is CD11c+ and CD103+ but characteristically CD25-negative, CD123-negative and BRAF wild-type, whereas this population is CD25-positive.
SMZL may be CD11c-positive and occasionally CD25-positive but is usually CD103-negative and scores low on the HCL flow score.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL is often CD11c-positive and can be CD103-positive but is CD25-negative and CD123-negative, lacking BRAF V600E.

62246.recognize_zh: TdT 核染色只在小葉周邊（上方）的皮質區呈密集棕色核陽性，中央髓質區與甲狀腺濾泡為陰性，這種皮質／髓質分區的 TdT 分布是正常胸腺的特徵。
features: Dense nuclear TdT positivity confined to the peripheral (cortical) portions of the thymic lobules
Paler central lymphoid zone largely TdT-negative, corresponding to medulla
Sharp, compartmentalized boundary between TdT-positive and TdT-negative regions
Small scattered clusters of TdT-positive cells at the lobule edges
Adjacent thyroid follicles and adipose tissue negative; linear fold artifacts present
62246.describe_en: TdT immunohistochemistry shows strong nuclear staining of densely packed lymphocytes restricted to the outer cortical regions of the lymphoid lobules, while the central medullary zones and a larger peripheral lymphoid area are negative. The adjacent thyroid follicles are negative. This zonal cortex-predominant distribution of immature TdT-positive T cells reflects normal thymic organization rather than an infiltrative lymphoblastic process. Findings are consistent with a cervical thymic remnant with intermixed ectopic thyroid tissue.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblastic lymphoma shows diffuse, sheet-like TdT positivity that ignores and effaces the cortex-medulla boundary, whereas here TdT is compartmentalized to cortex with an intact epithelial framework.

Thymoma also contains TdT-positive immature T cells but forms an encapsulated mass with abnormal lobulation and expanded epithelium, rather than a small organized remnant with normal cortex-medulla ratio.
Indolent T-lymphoblastic proliferation occurs outside the thymus without an epithelial meshwork, whereas here the TdT-positive cells sit within CK5/6/p63-positive thymic epithelium.

62118.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片可見多顆碎裂紅血球（schistocytes），包括頭盔狀（helmet cell）、三角形與不規則碎片，並有少數小球形紅血球，血小板稀少，符合微血管病變性溶血（此例為非典型 HUS）。
features: Numerous schistocytes including helmet cells, triangular and irregular fragments
Occasional microspherocytes and crenated fragments
Normocytic red cell background with mild anisocytosis
Markedly reduced platelets, with only rare small platelets in the field
Single small lymphocyte; no nucleated red cells or blasts seen
62118.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous schistocytes, including helmet cells, triangular forms and irregular red cell fragments, with occasional microspherocytes. Platelets are markedly decreased, with only rare forms seen in this field. White cells in the field are unremarkable, and no leukemic cells are identified. Findings are consistent with a microangiopathic hemolytic anemia with thrombocytopenia; in a child with acute renal failure, no diarrheal prodrome and anti-complement factor H antibodies, this supports atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome.

ddx.vs: TTP shows an identical schistocytic smear, so it is separated by severely deficient ADAMTS13 activity (below 10%) rather than morphology.
STEC-HUS has the same smear but follows bloody diarrhea with stool Shiga toxin or E. coli O157 positivity, unlike complement-mediated aHUS.
DIC can show schistocytes but has prolonged PT/aPTT with low fibrinogen and high D-dimer, whereas coagulation tests are typically normal in aHUS.
Valve-related hemolysis shows schistocytes with normal platelet counts and no renal thrombotic microangiopathy.

62054.recognize_zh: 紅色免疫染色中倍下，許多比背景淋巴球大、輪廓不規則的細胞呈強烈膜狀陽性，背景小淋巴球全為陰性，且右上方陽性大細胞密度明顯增加、趨於聚集，提示大細胞增多、需評估是否進展。
features: Numerous large cells with strong membranous red staining and irregular, angulated outlines
Density of positive large cells increases toward the upper right, approaching clustering
Background small lymphocytes uniformly negative
Some positive profiles show granular or dendritic-appearing cytoplasmic extensions
No confluent sheets in this field; antibody identity not labeled
62054.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen, antibody not specified in the image) of lymph node at medium power shows numerous large cells with strong membranous staining and irregular outlines, set in a background of uniformly negative small lymphocytes. The positive large cells increase in density toward the upper right, where they approach but do not form confluent sheets. Some positive profiles have granular or process-like extensions, so a histiocytic marker cannot be fully excluded without the antibody label. If this represents a B-cell marker such as CD20, the numerous large positive cells in a B-cell-poor background raise concern for a T-cell-rich variant pattern or evolution toward T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma in this nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma; correlation with the labeled panel is required.

ddx.vs: THRLBCL has scattered large CD20+ B cells in a diffuse CD8+ T-cell and histiocyte background without residual CD21+ meshworks or PD-1+ rosettes.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma arising from NLPHL
ddx.vs: Transformation requires confluent sheets of large B cells, which are not present in this field despite increased density.

ddx.dx: Histiocyte-rich reactive process highlighted by CD68/CD163
ddx.vs: Histiocytes show granular cytoplasmic staining with dendritic or foamy morphology and bland nuclei, whereas LP cells show crisp membranous B-cell marker staining.

61990.recognize_zh: 高度細胞性骨髓中三系造血完整、巨核細胞形態正常；視野中央一個脂肪空泡被一圈同心排列的類上皮組織球及嗜伊紅纖維帶包圍，形成「甜甜圈」狀的環狀肉芽腫（ring / fibrin-ring granuloma）。
features: Hypercellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis
Megakaryocytes normal in number with normal lobated nuclei; no clustering or atypia
Central ring granuloma: clear lipid vacuole surrounded by a concentric rim of epithelioid histiocytes and eosinophilic fibrinoid material
Maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors fill the intertrabecular space
No caseous necrosis, sheets of atypical cells or fibrosis visible
Scattered adipocytes of normal size
61990.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis, including maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors and morphologically normal megakaryocytes. In the center of the field is a ring (doughnut) granuloma composed of a central clear lipid vacuole surrounded by a concentric rim of epithelioid histiocytes and eosinophilic fibrinoid material. No caseating necrosis, atypical lymphoid infiltrate, or fibrosis is seen. Findings are consistent with a fibrin-ring granuloma in an otherwise reactive marrow; although classically associated with Q fever, this pattern is also reported with EBV, CMV, other infections, drugs and Hodgkin lymphoma, and special stains and cultures are warranted.

ddx.vs: Lipogranulomas are loose aggregates of foamy histiocytes and lymphocytes around fat droplets without the organized concentric fibrin ring.
Infectious epithelioid granulomas are solid, may show caseous necrosis and Langhans giant cells, and contain AFB- or GMS-positive organisms rather than a central fat vacuole with a fibrin ring.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma with granulomatous reaction
ddx.vs: Hodgkin involvement shows CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a fibrotic mixed infiltrate, which is not present here.
An arteriole has a smooth muscle wall and endothelial-lined lumen containing red cells, whereas the ring granuloma contains a lipid vacuole surrounded by histiocytes and fibrin.

61926.recognize_zh: 與中央的小淋巴球相比，紅血球體積偏小（小球性），可見少數橢圓形、淚滴狀及口形樣紅血球，但整體大小相當一致、蒼白區不太擴大；這種「輕度小球性、紅血球形狀輕微異常而無明顯缺鐵變化」的抹片符合β-地中海型貧血帶因者，但單靠形態無法確診。
features: Red cells appear small relative to the nucleus of the central small lymphocyte, suggesting microcytosis
Relatively uniform red cell size (little anisocytosis) with mild poikilocytosis: occasional elliptocytes, teardrop-like and stomatocyte-like cells
Central pallor present but not markedly expanded; hypochromia is mild at most
No definite target cells, basophilic stippling or nucleated red cells in this field
Single small mature lymphocyte with condensed chromatin and scant blue cytoplasm; occasional platelets
61926.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells that appear microcytic relative to a small lymphocyte, with relatively uniform size and mild poikilocytosis including occasional elliptocytes and teardrop-like forms. Hypochromia is mild, and target cells and basophilic stippling are not conspicuous in this field. White cells and platelets are unremarkable in this limited view. The findings are nonspecific but compatible with thalassemia trait; correlation with red cell indices (low MCV with high RBC count) and hemoglobin HPLC showing increased HbA2 is needed for a diagnosis of beta-thalassemia trait.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows more anisocytosis (high RDW), pronounced hypochromia and pencil cells with a low RBC count and low ferritin, whereas thalassemia trait has uniform microcytes with a high RBC count.
Morphology is essentially identical; separation requires a normal HbA2 on HPLC and alpha-globin gene deletion testing.
ACD is usually normocytic or mildly microcytic with low serum iron but normal-to-high ferritin and normal HbA2.
Normal red cells are about the size of a small lymphocyte nucleus; confirmation of microcytosis requires the MCV rather than visual comparison.

61798.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中大量紅血球的血紅素被推向細胞一側，另一側只剩透明的細胞膜囊泡，形成水泡細胞／半鬼影細胞（blister cell/hemighost），為 G6PD 缺乏在氧化壓力（rasburicase）下溶血的特徵。
features: Numerous red cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side and a clear membrane-bound vesicle on the other (blister cells/hemighosts)
Eccentrocytes with sharply demarcated, crescentic pale zones
Occasional spherocytic and irregularly contracted red cells
Single small mature lymphocyte in the center
Scattered platelets; no schistocytes or red cell agglutinates evident
61798.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous red cells in which hemoglobin is retracted to one side of the cell, leaving a sharply demarcated clear membrane vesicle, forming blister cells (hemighosts) and eccentrocytes, together with occasional irregularly contracted cells. A single small lymphocyte is present, and schistocytes and agglutination are not seen. Heinz bodies require a supravital stain for demonstration. Findings are consistent with acute oxidative hemolysis, as seen in G6PD deficiency after rasburicase exposure.
