features: Many large cells with oval, vesicular nuclei and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm (histiocyte-like)
Some cells contain clustered red cells, suggestive of hemophagocytosis
Admixed eosinophils, lymphocytes and erythroid precursors
Interstitial hemorrhage and loosely cohesive architecture
Occasional mitotic figure; giant granules not resolvable on H&E
2982.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a hypercellular, hemorrhagic marrow with a prominent population of large histiocyte-like cells with oval vesicular nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm, several of which appear to contain clustered erythrocytes. Eosinophils, lymphocytes and erythroid precursors are admixed. Giant cytoplasmic granules cannot be assessed on this section. In the setting of Chediak-Higashi syndrome, findings are suggestive of the accelerated phase with hemophagocytic histiocytic infiltration; CD163 immunostain and aspirate correlation are recommended.

ddx.vs: Histology overlaps; LYST genotype and giant granules on aspirate favor CHS.
LCH cells have grooved nuclei and are CD1a/langerin positive, without prominent hemophagocytosis.
Mast cells are spindled or oval with clear cytoplasm, form paratrabecular/perivascular aggregates and express tryptase/CD117.

2854.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E：瀰漫的小至中型淋巴細胞，核圓或輕度不規則，細胞質淡染較豐富而使細胞彼此間隔（單核球樣 monocytoid B 細胞），其中混有核較大、帶核仁的轉化細胞，符合邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheet of small to intermediate lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with moderately dense chromatin
Moderate pale eosinophilic to clear cytoplasm giving monocytoid appearance and cell spacing
Scattered larger cells with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli
Occasional plasmacytoid cells; no follicular architecture in this field
2854.describe_en: H&E section of lymph node shows a diffuse infiltrate of small to intermediate lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei and moderate amounts of pale to clear cytoplasm, imparting a monocytoid appearance. Scattered larger transformed cells with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli, as well as occasional plasmacytoid cells, are admixed. Findings are consistent with marginal zone lymphoma; immunophenotyping to exclude other small B-cell lymphomas (CD5, CD10, cyclin D1 negative) is recommended.

ddx.vs: SLL cells have scant cytoplasm and round clumped nuclei with pale proliferation centers, and are CD5 and LEF1 positive.
Mantle cells are monotonous with scant cytoplasm and irregular nuclei, lack transformed large cells, and are cyclin D1/SOX11 positive.
Follicular lymphoma shows centrocytes with angulated cleaved nuclei in a follicular pattern and is CD10/BCL6 positive.
Reactive monocytoid B cells occupy sinuses around preserved follicles and are polytypic without architectural effacement.

2790.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中，一片小型、核深染略不規則、細胞質極少的淋巴球間質性浸潤，細胞形態溫和、無明顯核仁或核分裂；形態上看不出 B 或 T，需免疫染色證實是 rituximab 相關的 T 細胞增生。
features: Dense interstitial infiltrate of small lymphoid cells
Small round to slightly irregular hyperchromatic nuclei; scant cytoplasm
No conspicuous nucleoli, large atypical cells or mitotic activity
Admixed larger cells with vesicular oval nuclei (histiocytes/endothelial/stromal cells)
Loose edematous stroma with small vessels; fat spaces at the edges
2790.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows an interstitial collection of small lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm, admixed with scattered histiocytes, endothelial cells and small vessels. Cytologic atypia, large transformed cells and mitoses are not seen. Some small dark round nuclei could also represent erythroid precursors, so lineage assessment requires immunohistochemistry. In a post-rituximab setting, a CD3-positive, CD20/PAX5-negative infiltrate would be consistent with rituximab-associated marrow T-cell hyperplasia.

ddx.vs: Residual lymphoma shows PAX5/CD79a-positive B cells with light-chain restriction, whereas reactive infiltrates are CD3-positive T-cell predominant.
T-LGL forms intrasinusoidal linear arrays of CD8+/TIA-1+/granzyme B+ cells with clonal TCR rearrangement.
Erythroid precursors have perfectly round nuclei with perinuclear clearing, form clusters and stain for E-cadherin/glycophorin/CD71 rather than CD3.
PTCL shows cytologic atypia, larger cells, aberrant loss of pan-T antigens and a clonal TCR rearrangement.

2598.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中三顆循環母細胞，核染色質細緻、核質比高，細胞質中等量藍色並在核旁有淡染區，未見明顯Auer小體；形態支持骨髓母細胞，但t(8;21)須靠細胞遺傳學確認。
features: Three circulating blasts, roughly twice the diameter of red cells
High N:C ratio with round to slightly indented nuclei
Fine, evenly dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm with a paler paranuclear zone in some cells
No definite granules or Auer rods resolved
Background red cells normocytic with some overlap; platelets not prominent
2598.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three circulating blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to slightly indented nuclei, fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cytoplasm is moderately basophilic, and a paler paranuclear zone is seen in some cells. Definite granules or Auer rods are not identified at this resolution. Red cells appear normocytic. Findings are consistent with circulating myeloblasts; specific assignment to AML with t(8;21) requires cytogenetic or molecular confirmation of RUNX1::RUNX1T1.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts usually have scantier cytoplasm and more condensed chromatin, and t(8;21) AML often coexpresses CD19 and PAX5, so flow cytometry and cytogenetics are required.
Monoblasts and promonocytes have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with folded delicate nuclei and are nonspecific esterase positive.
A leukoerythroblastic picture shows nucleated red cells and a left-shifted spectrum of maturing myeloid cells rather than isolated monotonous blasts.

2406.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆極大的細胞，細胞質豐富且呈深藍色，核圓形、含明顯核仁，體積數倍於旁邊骨髓細胞，背景造血成熟正常，符合多發性骨髓瘤中的大型不典型漿細胞。
features: Single giant cell with abundant intensely basophilic cytoplasm
Large round nucleus with fine to slightly open chromatin and a visible nucleolus
Low to moderate N:C ratio; paranuclear hof not well defined
Adjacent cell with pale gray-blue cytoplasm abutting the large cell
Background trilineage hematopoiesis with maturing neutrophils, erythroid precursors and eosinophils
2406.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a background of normal maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors with a single markedly enlarged cell. The cell has abundant, intensely basophilic cytoplasm and a large round nucleus with relatively fine chromatin and a visible nucleolus, consistent with a large atypical or immature plasma cell. The perinuclear hof is not distinct. Correlation with CD138 staining, flow cytometric light chain restriction, and serum protein studies is required; findings are compatible with plasma cell myeloma with large atypical plasma cells.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts usually appear in groups with a comet-shaped outline and a pale zone distant from the nucleus, and are CD138/cytoplasmic light chain negative.
Pronormoblasts are smaller with very high N:C ratio, cytoplasmic blebs and fine nuclear chromatin with multiple nucleoli, and are CD71/E-cadherin positive.
Metastatic cells are usually cohesive clusters with pleomorphic nuclei and are cytokeratin or other lineage-marker positive rather than CD138/light chain restricted.

2342.recognize_zh: 低倍下抹片被大片淡紫紅色、無定形帶纖維狀條紋的膠狀基質佔滿，有核細胞非常稀少，只剩零星小點，這是厭食症造成的骨髓膠狀轉化（gelatinous transformation / serous atrophy）。
features: Extensive amorphous, pale magenta-to-violet ground substance with streaky, fibrillar texture filling most of the smear
Marked paucity of nucleated hematopoietic cells, only scattered small dots at low power
Interspersed brownish areas of peripheral blood red cells
Scattered round clear vacuoles consistent with small fat droplets
Small dark refractile fragment (debris/artifact) at left
2342.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows abundant amorphous, pale magenta extracellular ground substance with a streaky fibrillar texture, occupying most of the preparation. Nucleated hematopoietic cells are markedly decreased and appear only as scattered small cells, with admixed areas of blood. No particles of normal cellular marrow or abnormal cell clusters are seen. Findings are consistent with gelatinous transformation (serous atrophy) of the marrow, as seen in anorexia nervosa and severe malnutrition; detailed cytology requires higher magnification.

ddx.vs: Amyloid appears as glassy, often perivascular deposits and is Congo red positive with apple-green birefringence, whereas gelatinous material is Alcian blue positive and Congo red negative.
Necrosis shows ghost-like degenerated cells with indistinct outlines and granular eosinophilic debris rather than an acellular mucoid matrix.
Aplastic marrow is hypocellular but replaced by normal-appearing fat without extracellular gelatinous ground substance.

2278.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中幾乎全為大小一致的中小型芽細胞，核圓或略有凹陷、細胞質極少，正常造血細胞罕見，呈單調的淋巴芽細胞浸潤；T 或 B 系須以流式鑑定。
features: Monotonous population of small-to-medium blasts replacing marrow elements
Very high N:C ratio with scant rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented nuclei with occasional clefts
Fine to slightly condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this magnification
Scattered fat spaces and particle fragments; normal maturing myeloid and erythroid cells rare
2278.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate magnification shows cellular particles and trails composed almost entirely of a monotonous population of small-to-medium blasts. The cells have very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to indented nuclei, relatively fine chromatin, and scant agranular cytoplasm. Maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors are markedly reduced. The morphology is that of lymphoblastic leukemia; flow cytometric demonstration of cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT is required for T-lineage assignment. Findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Cannot be separated morphologically; flow cytometry shows B-lineage markers (CD19, CD79a, CD22) without cytoplasmic CD3.
CLL cells have coarse, clumped 'soccer-ball' chromatin and mature CD5+/CD23+ phenotype without TdT or CD34.
Hematogones are a minor population with a spectrum of maturation by flow rather than a sheet-like, monotonous replacement of the marrow.

2150.recognize_zh: 高倍下一群細胞中混有核呈腎形或折疊、胞質灰藍含空泡的單核球與前單核球，以及骨髓細胞、分葉嗜中性球與小淋巴球，顯示單核球系與顆粒球系共同增生，符合 CMML 的骨髓表現。
features: Cluster of mixed monocytic and granulocytic cells
Monocytes and promonocytes with reniform to folded nuclei and fine chromatin
Gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and occasional vacuoles
Admixed myelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils
Small lymphocytes and an erythroid precursor present; blasts not predominant
2150.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a cluster of mixed cells comprising monocytes and promonocytes with reniform to folded nuclei, fine chromatin, and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm, together with myelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils, and occasional small lymphocytes. Blasts do not predominate, and overt granulocytic dysplasia is not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with a myelomonocytic proliferation compatible with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia when correlated with peripheral blood monocytosis.

ddx.vs: Requires ≥20% myeloblasts, monoblasts, and promonocytes, which are not predominant here.
Morphology may overlap; lack of dysplasia and absence of clonal markers favor a reactive process.
aCML has prominent dysgranulopoiesis with monocytes <10% of peripheral WBC.

2086.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中有一顆小型成熟淋巴球，旁邊另一顆淋巴球的核被一條深而清楚的裂縫從中切開（cleaved lymphocyte），這種帶深裂痕的小淋巴球配合百日咳臨床，是 pertussis 淋巴球增多的典型表現。
features: Small mature lymphocyte with a deep, sharply defined nuclear cleft dividing the nucleus into two halves
Condensed, clumped mature chromatin without nucleoli
Scant cytoplasm, similar size to an adjacent normal small lymphocyte
Adjacent round small lymphocyte with dense chromatin for comparison
Unremarkable red cells and a few platelets in the background
2086.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two small mature lymphocytes. One has a deep, cleanly incised nuclear cleft producing a bilobed, 'butt-like' appearance, with mature condensed chromatin, no nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. The accompanying lymphocyte is round and normal-appearing, and the red cells and platelets are unremarkable. In a child with paroxysmal cough and absolute lymphocytosis, findings are consistent with reactive lymphocytosis of Bordetella pertussis infection.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma in leukemic phase (buttock cells)
ddx.vs: Leukemic FL shows a monotonous clonal population of cleaved cells in adults, with CD10+ light-chain-restricted B cells and BCL2 rearrangement, whereas pertussis lymphocytosis is polyclonal and predominantly T-cell in children.
Sézary cells have cerebriform, convoluted nuclei with multiple grooves rather than a single clean cleft and show CD4+ CD7-/CD26- clonal T cells.
ATLL cells are multilobated 'flower cells' with several petal-like lobes, whereas the cell here has a single deep cleft.

1958.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結正常結構被瀰漫性浸潤取代，看不到清楚的濾泡；可見淡染的細胞群與分支狀血管散布在深染的淋巴球之間，呈斑駁的多形性外觀，這是 AITL 的典型低倍型態。
features: Diffuse effacement of nodal architecture without well-formed follicles or sinuses
Mottled appearance with pale-staining clusters of cells alternating with darker lymphocyte-rich areas
Numerous vessels, some with pink walls, distributed throughout (upper center)
Polymorphous cellular infiltrate; cytologic detail limited by low magnification and image resolution
1958.describe_en: Low-power lymph node section shows diffuse effacement of normal architecture by a polymorphous infiltrate, with no identifiable reactive follicles. The infiltrate has a mottled appearance with pale-staining cell clusters and numerous scattered vessels interspersed among darker small lymphocytes. The image resolution does not permit assessment of cytologic atypia or high endothelial venule morphology. In the appropriate immunophenotypic context, findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive nodes retain follicles and patent sinuses and lack clonal TFH-phenotype T cells.
cHL shows scattered CD30/CD15-positive Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells rather than atypical clear T cells with PD-1/CXCL13 expression and expanded CD21 meshworks.
THRLBCL contains scattered large CD20-positive B cells in a background of non-clonal T cells and histiocytes, without expanded FDC meshworks around vessels.

1894.recognize_zh: 未染色的相位差顯微鏡（phase-contrast）影像中，三顆單核細胞的整圈細胞膜都伸出細密的毛狀突起，細胞核圓而居中，這是活細胞狀態下毛狀細胞「毛」最直接的呈現。
features: Unstained wet preparation viewed by phase-contrast microscopy
Mononuclear cells larger than adjacent red cells
Fine, circumferential hair-like cytoplasmic projections around the entire cell border
Round to oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin
Moderate cytoplasm with small refractile granules; red cells at upper left for scale
1894.describe_en: Phase-contrast preparation of unstained cells shows three mononuclear cells, larger than the adjacent erythrocytes, with round to oval nuclei and a moderate rim of cytoplasm. The entire cell circumference bears numerous fine, hair-like cytoplasmic projections. No stain-dependent features can be assessed. Findings are consistent with hairy cells of hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: SMZL cells show short villi concentrated at one or both poles rather than fine circumferential projections, and are CD103/CD25/annexin A1 negative.

ddx.dx: Drying or crenation artifact of lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Artifactual crenation produces blunt, uniform spicules on many cell types, whereas hairy projections are long, fine and confined to the neoplastic cells, confirmed by flow cytometry.
HCL-v cells also have projections but have a prominent nucleolus and lack CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.

1766.recognize_zh: 抹片中大型腫瘤細胞帶有豐富深藍色、含許多小空泡的細胞質，細胞核呈馬蹄形、多葉或中央有空洞的甜甜圈形（doughnut cell），核仁明顯，是間變性大細胞淋巴瘤的典型細胞學表現。
features: Very large cells with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous small clear vacuoles
Horseshoe-shaped, multilobated, and doughnut-shaped nuclei, including one with a central cytoplasmic pseudoinclusion
Finely granular to reticular chromatin with multiple small nucleoli
Marked nuclear pleomorphism with some cells showing a paler Golgi region
Background red cells and occasional small mature lymphocytes for size comparison
1766.describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained cytologic smear shows numerous very large neoplastic cells with abundant deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm. Nuclei are markedly pleomorphic, including horseshoe-shaped, multilobated, and doughnut forms with a central cytoplasmic pseudoinclusion, with fine chromatin and multiple nucleoli. Small mature lymphocytes are present for comparison. The specimen source is not indicated in the image. Findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma; confirmation by flow cytometry or CD30 and ALK immunostaining is recommended.

ddx.vs: Nonhematopoietic tumors form cohesive clusters with nuclear molding and lack the discohesive horseshoe and doughnut nuclei; they are CD45 and CD30 negative.
Reed-Sternberg cells are binucleate or multinucleate with huge eosinophilic macronucleoli and less basophilic cytoplasm, scattered in a mixed background rather than in sheets.
Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei with coarse chromatin and pink granular cytoplasm budding platelets rather than deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm.
Burkitt cells also have basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm but are medium-sized and monotonous with round nuclei, not markedly pleomorphic horseshoe nuclei.

1702.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片（H&E），左上角可見骨小樑，旁邊骨髓腔被成片不成熟細胞填滿，核卵圓或不規則、染色質淡、部分有核仁，正常三系造血與脂肪幾乎消失，符合急性白血病浸潤。
features: Bone trabecula at the upper left edge with hypercellular intertrabecular space
Diffuse sheets of immature cells effacing normal trilineage hematopoiesis and fat
Oval to irregular nuclei with vesicular chromatin and occasional small nucleoli
Scant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Scattered small clear spaces; megakaryocytes not evident in this field
1702.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow adjacent to a bony trabecula. The marrow space is diffusely replaced by sheets of immature cells with oval to irregular nuclei, vesicular chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and scant cytoplasm, and normal fat, erythroid islands and megakaryocytes are not evident in this field. Image resolution limits finer cytologic detail. Findings are consistent with extensive involvement by acute leukemia; lineage (including mixed phenotype) must be established by immunohistochemistry (e.g., MPO, CD19, PAX5, CD3, TdT, CD34) and flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Histologically similar; confirmed by TdT with PAX5/CD19 or CD3 positivity and MPO negativity on IHC.
Shows MPO/lysozyme-positive blasts, sometimes with residual dysplastic megakaryocytes, and lacks B- or T-lineage-defining antigens.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving marrow
ddx.vs: Cells are larger with more pleomorphic nuclei and prominent nucleoli, and are TdT- and CD34-negative mature B cells.
Tends to form cohesive nests with desmoplastic stroma and is CD45-negative with epithelial or neural markers.

1638.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見排列成條索的細長粉紅色細胞，核呈卵圓形、染色質細緻，圍出含小淋巴球的腔隙，右下有內襯扁平細胞的裂隙，符合脾臟紅髓的竇內襯細胞（littoral cells）與脾索，並非腫瘤。
features: Elongated cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval vesicular nuclei arranged in cords and along channels (compatible with sinus lining cells/histiocytes)
Small round lymphocytes clustered within the delimited spaces
Occasional larger cells with vesicular nuclei and small nucleoli
A cleft-like vascular space lined by flattened cells at the lower right
No atypical infiltrate, hemophagocytosis, or granulomas
1638.describe_en: High-power section shows cords and channels lined by elongated cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval vesicular nuclei, compatible with splenic sinus lining (littoral) cells and cordal histiocytes, enclosing clusters of small lymphocytes. A cleft-like vascular space lined by flattened cells is present at the lower right. There is no monotonous atypical population or hemophagocytosis. In the context of this series, findings are consistent with normal splenic red pulp; the site cannot be confirmed from this field alone.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia, red pulp involvement
ddx.vs: HCL fills the cords and sinuses with monotonous cells having bean-shaped nuclei and clear cytoplasmic halos, rather than the mixed normal lymphocytes seen here.
HSTCL shows intrasinusoidal monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells that are CD3+ and usually TCR gamma-delta, which requires immunostains to exclude.
Littoral cell angioma forms a mass of anastomosing vascular channels with papillary tall lining cells, not a normal cord-sinus pattern.

1574.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片染色偏淡橘色、對比不佳，紅血球大小略不等，部分呈較小、深染且缺乏中央淡染區的細胞，少數紅血球內可見小而深色的點狀包涵體；染色品質限制判讀，無法確認具體診斷，只能歸為生成不足性貧血相關的非特異性紅血球變化。
features: Suboptimal, pale orange-tinted staining with poor contrast
Mild anisocytosis with a subset of smaller, denser red cells lacking central pallor
Occasional red cells containing single small dark dot-like inclusions (possible Howell-Jolly or Pappenheimer bodies)
Scattered small extracellular particles, possibly platelets or stain debris
No leukocytes, schistocytes or significant poikilocytosis in the field
1574.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, suboptimally stained with poor contrast, shows mild anisocytosis with a subset of smaller, dense red cells lacking central pallor. Occasional red cells contain small dark punctate inclusions that could represent Howell-Jolly bodies or Pappenheimer bodies, although overlying platelets or stain precipitate cannot be excluded at this quality. No leukocytes are present for assessment. The findings are nonspecific; correlation with red cell indices, reticulocyte count and an iron stain is required to support an underproduction anemia.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are multiple small peripheral clustered granules that stain with Prussian blue, whereas Howell-Jolly bodies are single, round and iron-negative.
Spherocytosis shows a prominent population of small dense cells with polychromasia and a negative DAT, rather than a sparse subset in a nonspecific smear.
Artifacts lie in a different focal plane and also appear between cells, while true inclusions stay within the red cell outline.

1446.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見數個巨核細胞，胞質豐富嗜酸性，核卻是單一圓形、不分葉（monolobated），與正常多分葉巨核細胞明顯不同；周圍有大量圓形深染核的紅血球系前驅細胞，符合 del(5q) MDS。
features: Megakaryocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and single round, non-lobated nuclei
Megakaryocytes of normal to slightly small size, scattered singly
Numerous erythroid precursors with round, dark, condensed nuclei
Admixed granulocytic precursors; no obvious clusters of blasts
Hematopoietic tissue interspersed with fat spaces
1446.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows hematopoietic tissue interspersed with fat, containing scattered megakaryocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and single round, non-lobated nuclei. The background shows numerous erythroid precursors with round condensed nuclei and admixed granulocytic cells, without obvious blast clusters at this magnification. Findings are consistent with the hypolobated megakaryocytes of myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q); cytogenetic confirmation and blast enumeration are required.

ddx.vs: ET shows large to giant megakaryocytes with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei in loose clusters rather than monolobated forms.
Reactive megakaryocytes retain normal nuclear lobation and usually occur without other dysplastic features.
This entity shows micromegakaryocytes or megakaryocytes with widely separated nuclei, and cytogenetics lack isolated del(5q).

1510.recognize_zh: 這是右髖關節與股骨近端 X 光片（非型態圖）：股骨近端與骨盆骨質普遍稀疏，股骨幹與轉子區出現多發性、邊界清楚、無周邊硬化的溶骨性病灶（punched-out lytic lesions）與皮質內側侵蝕，是多發性骨髓瘤的典型骨骼影像。
features: Frontal radiograph of the right hip and proximal femur
Diffuse osteopenia of the pelvis and proximal femur
Multiple small, well-defined lucent (lytic) lesions without sclerotic rims in the femoral shaft and trochanteric region
Endosteal scalloping/thinning of the femoral cortex
No periosteal reaction or displaced pathologic fracture visible
1510.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic image: a frontal radiograph of the right hip and proximal femur. There is diffuse osteopenia with multiple well-defined, punched-out lytic lesions lacking sclerotic margins in the proximal femoral shaft and trochanteric region, with endosteal cortical scalloping. No periosteal reaction or obvious displaced fracture is seen. Multiple non-sclerotic lytic lesions with osteopenia are characteristic of multiple myeloma bone disease and indicate risk for pathologic fracture; lesions are typically cold on bone scan, so skeletal survey, low-dose whole-body CT or PET-CT is preferred for staging.

102.recognize_zh: 血片中的淋巴球細胞質邊緣呈毛刷狀細長突起（hairy projections）；骨髓切片細胞間距寬、胞質透亮，呈「荷包蛋」（fried-egg）樣瀰漫浸潤；CD20、TRAP、Annexin A1 強陽性，流式為亮 CD20/CD11c/CD25/CD103 陽性，BRAF V600E 突變，即為毛狀細胞白血病。
features: Peripheral blood: small to medium lymphoid cells with oval to slightly indented nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, and pale blue cytoplasm with circumferential fine hair-like projections

Bone marrow biopsy: hypercellular marrow diffusely infiltrated by evenly spaced cells with round to reniform nuclei and abundant clear cytoplasm (fried-egg appearance), with reduced normal hematopoiesis
IHC: diffuse CD20, TRAP and annexin A1 positivity in the infiltrate; annexin A1-negative residual cells stand out
Flow cytometry: bright CD19/CD20 B cells co-expressing CD11c, CD25 and CD103, CD5 and CD38 negative, lambda light-chain restricted
BRAF V600E melting-curve assay: patient shows an additional lower-temperature mutant peak (~59 C) beside the wild-type peak (~64.5 C) seen in the control
102.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered atypical lymphoid cells with moderate pale cytoplasm bearing circumferential hair-like projections; no neutrophils or monocytes are present in these fields. The bone marrow biopsy is hypercellular and diffusely infiltrated by monotonous cells with bland round to oval nuclei and abundant clear cytoplasm imparting a fried-egg pattern, with marked reduction of normal hematopoietic elements. Immunohistochemistry shows the infiltrate to be CD20, TRAP and annexin A1 positive, and flow cytometry identifies a lambda-restricted, bright CD20-positive B-cell population co-expressing CD11c, CD25 and CD103 and lacking CD5 and CD38. Molecular testing demonstrates BRAF V600E. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-v has prominent central nucleoli, leukocytosis without monocytopenia, and is CD25 negative, annexin A1 negative and BRAF V600E wild-type.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have polar short projections, infiltrate the marrow in an intrasinusoidal or nodular pattern, and are typically CD103, CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E negative.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL has broad-based villi, an intrasinusoidal marrow pattern, and is usually CD25, CD123 and annexin A1 negative without BRAF V600E.

ddx.dx: Systemic mastocytosis or other clear-cell marrow infiltrate
ddx.vs: Mast cell infiltrates are spindled and paratrabecular with CD117/tryptase positivity, whereas this infiltrate is CD20, TRAP and annexin A1 positive.

102.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD20, TRAP, annexin A1
captions: Peripheral blood smear: lymphoid cells with hairy cytoplasmic projections
Bone marrow biopsy H&E: diffuse fried-egg infiltrate
Bone marrow IHC: CD20, TRAP and annexin A1 positive
Flow cytometry: bright CD19/CD20 B cells positive for CD25, CD103 and CD11c
Flow cytometry: CD5-negative, CD38-negative, lambda-restricted B cells with HCL marker panel
BRAF V600E melting-curve analysis: mutant peak in patient versus normal control

38.recognize_zh: 4 歲男童血液與骨髓中見大量小至中型、高核質比、染色質細緻、胞質稀少淡藍且無顆粒的母細胞；骨髓切片 100% 被取代，IHC 為 CD79a 與 TdT 陽性、CD34 陰性，流式 CD19+/CD10+、CD45−、表面輕鏈陰性，符合 B 淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: Small to intermediate blasts (1-2x lymphocyte size) with very high N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented nuclei with fine, homogeneous chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant, pale to moderately basophilic agranular cytoplasm without Auer rods
Aspirate: cohesive-appearing clusters of monotonous blasts with smudged cells
BM biopsy: 100% cellular marrow with sheets of blasts replacing normal hematopoiesis
IHC: CD79a+, TdT+ (nuclear), CD34 negative in blasts (vessels positive); flow CD19+ CD10+ CD45- CD20- CD13- sIg light chain-negative
38.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts that are small to intermediate in size with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular cytoplasm. The bone marrow aspirate contains sheets and clusters of similar monotonous blasts, and the core biopsy is 100% cellular with diffuse replacement by blasts and near-total loss of normal trilineage hematopoiesis. Immunohistochemistry shows the blasts are positive for CD79a and TdT and negative for CD34 (which highlights only endothelium), and flow cytometry of the blood demonstrates a CD19+, CD10+ blast population that is largely CD34-negative and negative for CD45, CD20, CD13 and surface light chains. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma, NOS; cytogenetic and molecular studies are needed for genetic subclassification.

ddx.vs: Hematogones show a continuous maturation spectrum (CD34/TdT to CD20) with dim CD10 and normal CD45, and never replace 100% of the marrow as here.
AML blasts may look identical but express CD13/CD33/CD117 or MPO and lack CD19/CD79a/CD10, whereas these blasts are CD19+CD10+ and CD13-negative.
T-ALL blasts are morphologically similar but express cytoplasmic CD3 and CD7 without CD19/CD79a, and often present with a mediastinal mass.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, are TdT-negative and surface light chain-restricted with MYC rearrangement, unlike these TdT+ sIg-negative blasts.

38.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD79a, TdT, CD34; flow cytometry
captions: Peripheral blood: three small lymphoblasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Bone marrow aspirate: clusters of monotonous lymphoblasts
Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E): 100% cellularity with marrow replaced by blasts, low and high power
H&E and IHC: blasts positive for CD79a and TdT, negative for CD34 (endothelium positive)
Flow cytometry: CD45-negative blasts positive for CD19 and CD10, largely CD34-negative, negative for CD5, CD13, CD20 and surface light chains

60070.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片幾乎沒有脂肪，大量核圓、深染、有核周空暈的小圓細胞成群排列（紅血球前驅細胞），間有數個巨核細胞；呈現富細胞性骨髓伴紅血球系增生，對應先天性鐵粒幼紅血球貧血。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with near-absence of fat
Erythroid hyperplasia: numerous small round cells with dense, round hyperchromatic nuclei and perinuclear clearing, forming clusters
Scattered larger erythroid precursors with more open chromatin
Megakaryocytes present, without obvious clustering or marked atypia
Interspersed extravasated red cells; ring sideroblasts cannot be assessed on H&E
60070.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with near-complete loss of fat. There is prominent erythroid hyperplasia, with sheets and clusters of erythroid precursors having round hyperchromatic nuclei and perinuclear halos, accompanied by maturing granulocytic elements and normal-appearing megakaryocytes. Features of the underlying ineffective erythropoiesis are nonspecific on H&E, and ring sideroblasts require an iron stain on the aspirate. In the appropriate context (microcytic anemia, ring sideroblasts, ALAS2 mutation), findings are consistent with congenital sideroblastic anemia.

ddx.vs: Shows similar reactive erythroid hyperplasia, but lacks ring sideroblasts on iron stain and has reticulocytosis rather than ineffective erythropoiesis.
Also shows erythroid hyperplasia with microcytosis, but ring sideroblasts are absent and hemoglobin analysis shows elevated HbF/HbA2.
Occurs in older adults with macrocytosis, dysplastic megakaryocytes, and SF3B1 mutation rather than congenital microcytosis.
Composed of sheets of immature proerythroblasts (≥30%) with p53 overexpression, rather than maturing normoblasts.

3430.recognize_zh: 周邊血中兩顆小至中型淋巴樣細胞，胞質稀少、核輪廓不規則，其中一顆核有明顯凹陷/切跡（notched），染色質成熟、無明顯核仁；雖不是典型的深裂「臀型」細胞，仍提示濾泡性淋巴瘤周邊血浸潤，須以流式細胞儀（CD10+）確認。
features: Two small to intermediate lymphoid cells, slightly larger than red cells
Scant rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm (high N:C ratio)
Irregular nuclear contours with indentation/notching; classic deep clefts not prominent
Condensed mature chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli
Normochromic normocytic background red cells
3430.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two small to intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm and irregular, indented nuclear contours with mature condensed chromatin and no conspicuous nucleoli. The deep, cleaved 'buttock' nuclei classically described in follicular lymphoma are not prominent in these cells, which are also somewhat larger than typical. Background red cells are unremarkable. In a patient with known follicular lymphoma, the findings are consistent with circulating lymphoma cells with atypical morphology; flow cytometry demonstrating a light chain-restricted CD10+ B-cell population is required, as morphology alone cannot distinguish other small B-cell lymphomas.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are small and round with 'soccer ball' chromatin and smudge cells, and are CD5+/CD23+/CD10- on flow cytometry.
MCL cells also show notched nuclei but are CD5+/CD10-/cyclin D1+ with t(11;14).
SMZL cells often have polar villous cytoplasmic projections and are CD5-/CD10- B cells.
Reactive lymphocytes are polymorphous with more abundant cytoplasm and show polyclonal light chain expression.

1062.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆很大的多核細胞，內含 4 個大小相近、彼此分開的圓形核，胞質豐富呈藍紫色並有細顆粒、邊界不規則，這是破骨細胞（osteoclast）；與巨核細胞「單一分葉核」的差別是本題重點。
features: Very large cell with abundant cytoplasm and irregular, frayed borders
Multiple (about 4) separate, uniform, round to oval nuclei
Nuclei with fine to slightly granular chromatin, each with a small nucleolus
Blue to lilac cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules
Surrounding neutrophils, a lymphocyte, and red cells for size comparison
1062.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a very large multinucleated cell with abundant blue-lilac, finely granular cytoplasm and irregular borders. It contains approximately four discrete, uniform, round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, which do not overlap or connect as a lobulated mass. Surrounding neutrophils, a lymphocyte, and red cells provide size reference. Findings are consistent with a normal osteoclast.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single multilobated, connected nucleus rather than multiple separate uniform nuclei.

ddx.dx: Multinucleated dysplastic megakaryocyte (widely separated nuclear lobes)
ddx.vs: Dysplastic megakaryocytes show separated lobes of varying size and dense chromatin in a granular pink cytoplasm, often with other dysplasia.
Tumor giant cells have pleomorphic, variably sized, hyperchromatic nuclei with prominent nucleoli and usually occur in cohesive clusters.
Histiocytic giant cells occur with granulomas or foreign material and lack the granular lilac cytoplasm typical of osteoclasts.

61350.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中大量小型成熟淋巴球，核圓、染色質呈塊狀（足球樣/龜殼樣 soccer-ball chromatin）、細胞質極少，並夾雜數個核被壓破而呈模糊網狀的破碎細胞（smudge cells）；這是慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）的經典抹片。
features: Absolute lymphocytosis of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes (about 1–1.5 times a red cell)
Round nuclei with coarsely clumped, block-like (soccer-ball) chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm
Multiple smudge (basket) cells: disrupted nuclei with smeared, reticulated chromatin and no cytoplasm
Occasional slightly larger lymphocyte with more cytoplasm; background red cells normocytic, few platelets
61350.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked increase in small, mature-appearing lymphocytes with round nuclei, coarsely clumped block-like chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm. Numerous smudge cells, representing fragile lymphocytes disrupted during smear preparation, are present. Prolymphocytes are not conspicuous and the red cells are largely unremarkable in this field. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD5+, CD23+, dim CD20 and dim surface light chain, CD200+) is recommended.

ddx.vs: MCL cells often have irregular or cleaved nuclei and are CD5+ but CD23-negative/dim, CD200-negative, and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive with t(11;14).
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous and polyclonal, and pertussis lymphocytes are small T cells with cleaved nuclei rather than a monotypic CD5+/CD23+ B-cell population.
SMZL cells have villous cytoplasmic projections and are usually CD5-negative, CD23-negative, and CD200 dim or negative.
FL cells are small with deeply notched or cleaved (buttock) nuclei and are CD10+ and CD5-negative.
